class FamilyAgentProposalApproveView(FamilyAgentAccessMixin, APIView):
    def post(self, request: Request, proposal_id: str) -> Response:
        family = self.get_current_family(request)
        user = cast(User, request.user)
        with transaction.atomic():
            proposal = self._lock_proposal(family, proposal_id)
            if proposal.status != FamilyAgentProposal.Status.PENDING_APPROVAL:
                raise ValidationError(
                    "Proposal is not pending approval and cannot be approved."
                )
            normalized_proposal_type = normalize_family_agent_proposal_type(
                proposal.proposal_type
            )
            if normalized_proposal_type is None:
                raise ValidationError(
                    f"Unsupported proposal type: {proposal.proposal_type}"
                )
            proposal_type_changed = normalized_proposal_type != proposal.proposal_type
            proposal.status = FamilyAgentProposal.Status.APPROVED
            proposal.proposal_type = normalized_proposal_type
            proposal.approved_by = user
            proposal.approved_at = timezone.now()
            proposal.error_text = ""
            update_fields = [
                "status",
                "approved_by",
                "approved_at",
                "error_text",
                "updated_at",
            ]
            if proposal_type_changed:
                update_fields.append("proposal_type")
            proposal.save(update_fields=update_fields)
            proposal.thread.save(update_fields=["updated_at"])
        commit_family_agent_proposal.delay(str(proposal.id))
        return Response(FamilyAgentProposalSerializer(proposal).data)

    def _lock_proposal(
        self, family: FamilyGroup, proposal_id: str
    ) -> FamilyAgentProposal:
        try:
            return (
                FamilyAgentProposal.objects.select_for_update(of=("self",))
                .select_related("thread")
                .get(id=proposal_id, thread__family=family)
            )
        except FamilyAgentProposal.DoesNotExist as exc:
            raise Http404 from exc

        with transaction.atomic():
            suggestion = self._lock_suggestion(family, suggestion_id)
            if suggestion.status != FamilyAgentMemorySuggestion.Status.PENDING_APPROVAL:
                raise ValidationError(
                    "Memory suggestion is not pending approval and cannot be approved."
                )
            payload = suggestion.proposed_item_json
            if not isinstance(payload, dict):
                raise ValidationError("Memory suggestion payload must be an object.")
            source_ref_json = payload.get("source_ref_json")
            if not isinstance(source_ref_json, dict):
                source_ref_json = {}
            proposed_family_id = payload.get("family_id") or source_ref_json.get(
                "family_id"
            )
            if proposed_family_id and str(proposed_family_id) != str(family.id):
                raise ValidationError(
                    "Only current-family facts can be saved to memory."
                )

            try:
                confidence = float(payload.get("confidence", 0.5))
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                confidence = 0.5

            memory_item = FamilyAgentMemoryItem.objects.create(
                family=family,
                category=payload.get("category", "preference"),
                title=payload.get("title", "Family preference"),
                body=payload.get("body", ""),
                confidence=confidence,
                source_kind=payload.get("source_kind", "agent_suggestion"),
                source_ref_json={
                    "suggestion_id": str(suggestion.id),
                    "run_id": str(suggestion.run_id),
                },
                created_by=user,
                updated_by=user,
            )

            suggestion.status = FamilyAgentMemorySuggestion.Status.APPROVED
            suggestion.approved_by = user
            suggestion.approved_at = timezone.now()
            suggestion.save(
                update_fields=["status", "approved_by", "approved_at", "updated_at"]
            )
            suggestion.thread.save(update_fields=["updated_at"])
        return Response(
            {
                "suggestion": FamilyAgentMemorySuggestionSerializer(suggestion).data,
                "memory_item": FamilyAgentMemoryItemSerializer(memory_item).data,
            }

                .select_related("thread")
                .get(id=suggestion_id, thread__family=family)

class FamilyAgentAccessMixin:
    def get_current_family(self, request: Request) -> FamilyGroup:
        user = cast(User, request.user)

        if not family_planner_feature_flags.is_enabled(user):
            raise NotFound("Family planner is not available.")

        family = get_user_immediate_family(user)
        if family is None:
            raise NotFound("Immediate family not found.")

        family = FamilyGroup.objects.select_related("feature_settings").get(
            id=family.id
        )
        if not family.feature_settings.agent_enabled:
            raise NotFound("Family planner is not enabled for this family.")

        has_permission, error_msg = validate_family_admin_permission(
            user,
            family,
            "access family planner",
        )
        if not has_permission and not user.is_staff:
            raise PermissionDenied(
                error_msg or "Only family admins can use the planner."
            )

        return family

    def get_active_threads_queryset(self, family: FamilyGroup) -> Any:
        return FamilyAgentThread.objects.filter(
            family=family,
            is_archived=False,
        ).order_by("-updated_at", "-created_at")

    def get_default_thread(
        self, family: FamilyGroup, *, user: User
    ) -> FamilyAgentThread:
        thread: FamilyAgentThread | None = self.get_active_threads_queryset(
            family
        ).first()
        if thread is not None:
            return thread
        return FamilyAgentThread.objects.create(
            family=family,
            created_by=user,
            title=DEFAULT_FAMILY_AGENT_THREAD_TITLE,
        )

    def get_thread_by_id(
        self, family: FamilyGroup, thread_id: str
    ) -> FamilyAgentThread:
        try:
            return FamilyAgentThread.objects.get(
                id=thread_id,
                family=family,
                is_archived=False,
            )
        except FamilyAgentThread.DoesNotExist as exc:
            raise Http404 from exc

    def resolve_thread(
        self,
        request: Request,
        family: FamilyGroup,
        *,
        user: User,
        thread_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> FamilyAgentThread:
        requested_thread_id = (
            thread_id
            or request.query_params.get("thread_id")
            or request.data.get("thread_id")
        )
        if requested_thread_id:
            return self.get_thread_by_id(family, requested_thread_id)
        return self.get_default_thread(family, user=user)


class FamilyAgentThreadView(FamilyAgentAccessMixin, APIView):
    def get(self, request: Request) -> Response:
        family = self.get_current_family(request)
        thread = self.resolve_thread(request, family, user=cast(User, request.user))
        serializer = FamilyAgentThreadSerializer(thread)
        return Response(serializer.data)

class FamilyAgentThreadListCreateView(FamilyAgentAccessMixin, APIView):
    def get(self, request: Request) -> Response:
        from django.conf import settings as django_settings

        family = self.get_current_family(request)
        include_archived = (
            str(request.query_params.get("include_archived", "")).lower() == "true"
        )
        cache_scope = f"{family.id}:archived" if include_archived else family.id
        cached_payload = get_desktop_response_cache(
            request,
            namespace=FAMILY_AGENT_THREADS_CACHE_NAMESPACE,
            scope_token=cache_scope,
        )
        if cached_payload is not None:
            return Response(cached_payload)

        user = cast(User, request.user)
        self.get_default_thread(family, user=user)
        if include_archived:
            threads = FamilyAgentThread.objects.filter(family=family).order_by(
                "-updated_at", "-created_at"
            )
        else:
            limit = int(
                getattr(
                    django_settings,
                    "FAMILY_AGENT_THREAD_LIST_DEFAULT_LIMIT",

        set_desktop_response_cache(

            namespace=FAMILY_AGENT_THREADS_CACHE_NAMESPACE,

class FamilyAgentMessageListCreateView(FamilyAgentAccessMixin, APIView):
    pagination_class = PageNumberPagination

    def get(self, request: Request) -> Response:
        family = self.get_current_family(request)
        thread = self.resolve_thread(request, family, user=cast(User, request.user))
        queryset = (
            thread.messages.select_related("author_user", "run")
            .prefetch_related(
                "attachments",
                "triggered_runs",
                "run__proposals",
                "run__memory_suggestions",
            )
            .order_by("-created_at")
        )
        paginator = self.pagination_class()
        page = paginator.paginate_queryset(queryset, request, view=self)
        serializer = FamilyAgentMessageSerializer(
            page,
            many=True,
            context={"request": request},
        )
        return paginator.get_paginated_response(serializer.data)

    def post(self, request: Request) -> Response:
        family = self.get_current_family(request)
        user = cast(User, request.user)

        serializer = FamilyAgentMessageCreateSerializer(data=request.data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        images = serializer.validated_data.get("images", [])
        context_payload = serializer.validated_data.get("context", {}) or {}
        budget_service = FamilyAgentBudgetService()
        capability_flags = budget_service.get_capability_flags(
            family=family,
            user=user,
        )
        uploaded_keys: list[str | None] = []

        capture_id = coerce_uuid(context_payload.get("capture_id"))
        has_linked_capture_photo = bool(
            capture_id
            and InboxCapture.objects.filter(
                id=capture_id,
                family=family,
                capture_type=InboxCapture.CaptureType.PHOTO,
            )
            .exclude(photo="")
            .exists()
        )

        if (images or has_linked_capture_photo) and not capability_flags[
            "image_attachments_enabled"
        ]:
            return _capability_unavailable_response(
                budget_service=budget_service,
                family=family,
                user=user,
                capability="image_attachments",
                message=IMAGE_ATTACHMENTS_UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE,
            )

        estimated_increment_micros = budget_service.estimate_preflight_cost_micros(
            message_text=serializer.validated_data["text"],
            image_count=len(images) + (1 if has_linked_capture_photo else 0),
        )
        try:
            budget_service.enforce_budget(
                family=family,
                user=user,
                estimated_increment_micros=estimated_increment_micros,
            )
        except FamilyAgentBudgetExceeded as exc:
            return _budget_error_response(exc)

        try:
            with transaction.atomic():
                # Serialize enqueue checks per family so parallel clients cannot all
                # pass the pending-run guard before any request creates its run.
                family = FamilyGroup.objects.select_for_update().get(id=family.id)
                if FamilyAgentRun.objects.filter(
                    thread__family=family,
                    status__in=[
                        FamilyAgentRun.Status.PENDING,
                        FamilyAgentRun.Status.RUNNING,
                    ],
                ).exists():
                    return _pending_run_response(
                        budget_service=budget_service,
                        family=family,
                        user=user,
                    )

                try:
                    budget_service.enforce_budget(
                        family=family,
                        user=user,
                        estimated_increment_micros=estimated_increment_micros,
                    )
                except FamilyAgentBudgetExceeded as exc:
                    return _budget_error_response(exc)

                resolution = resolve_effective_thread(
                    family=family,
                    user=user,
                    source_screen=context_payload.get("source_screen"),
                    requested_thread_id=(
                        str(serializer.validated_data["thread_id"])
                        if serializer.validated_data.get("thread_id")
                        else None
                    ),
                )
                thread = resolution.thread
                prior_message_count = thread.messages.count()
                user_message = FamilyAgentMessage.objects.create(
                    thread=thread,
                    author_user=user,
                    role=FamilyAgentMessage.Role.USER,
                    text=serializer.validated_data["text"],
                    status=FamilyAgentMessage.Status.COMPLETED,
                    context_json=context_payload,
                )

                image_attachment_count = 0
                for display_order, image in enumerate(images):
                    _create_message_image_attachment(
                        file_obj=image,
                        thread=thread,
                        message=user_message,
                        uploaded_by=user,
                        display_order=display_order,
                        uploaded_keys=uploaded_keys,
                    )
                    image_attachment_count += 1

                if _attach_linked_capture_photo(
                    family=family,
                    context_payload=context_payload,
                    thread=thread,
                    message=user_message,
                    uploaded_by=user,
                    display_order=image_attachment_count,
                    uploaded_keys=uploaded_keys,
                ):
                    image_attachment_count += 1

                runtime = HermesFamilyPlannerRuntime(
                    external_research_enabled=capability_flags[
                        "external_research_enabled"
                    ],
                )
                run = FamilyAgentRun.objects.create(
                    thread=thread,
                    trigger_message=user_message,
                    status=FamilyAgentRun.Status.PENDING,
                    runtime=runtime.runtime_name,
                    model_name=runtime.model_name,
                )
                user_message.run = run
                user_message.save(update_fields=["run", "updated_at"])
                if (
                    thread.title == DEFAULT_FAMILY_AGENT_THREAD_TITLE
                    and prior_message_count == 0
                    and user_message.text
                ):
                    thread.title = suggest_thread_title(user_message.text)
                    thread.save(update_fields=["title", "updated_at"])
                logger.info(
                    "Family planner queued run_id=%s thread_id=%s family_id=%s user_id=%s trigger_message_id=%s text_length=%s image_count=%s context_keys=%s",
                    run.id,
                    thread.id,
                    family.id,
                    user.id,
                    user_message.id,
                    len(user_message.text),
                    image_attachment_count,
                    sorted((user_message.context_json or {}).keys()),
                )
                thread.save(update_fields=["updated_at"])
        except Exception:
            PrivateMediaStorageService.delete_objects(uploaded_keys)
            raise

        _invalidate_family_agent_threads_cache(family)
        run_family_agent_turn.delay(str(run.id))
        if resolution.split_occurred and resolution.closed_thread_id:
            summarize_thread_for_handoff.delay(
                resolution.closed_thread_id,
                str(thread.id),
            )

        return Response(
            {
                "thread": FamilyAgentThreadSerializer(thread).data,
                "message": FamilyAgentMessageSerializer(
                    user_message,
                    context={"request": request},
                ).data,
                "run": FamilyAgentRunSerializer(run).data,
                "token_pressure": token_pressure(thread.prompt_tokens_estimate),
                "split_occurred": resolution.split_occurred,
                "closed_thread_id": resolution.closed_thread_id,
                "closed_reason": resolution.closed_reason,
            },
            status=status.HTTP_202_ACCEPTED,
        )


class FamilyAgentProposalApproveView(FamilyAgentAccessMixin, APIView):
    def post(self, request: Request, proposal_id: str) -> Response:
        family = self.get_current_family(request)
        user = cast(User, request.user)
        with transaction.atomic():
            proposal = self._lock_proposal(family, proposal_id)
            if proposal.status != FamilyAgentProposal.Status.PENDING_APPROVAL:
                raise ValidationError(
                    "Proposal is not pending approval and cannot be approved."
                )
            normalized_proposal_type = normalize_family_agent_proposal_type(
                proposal.proposal_type
            )
            if normalized_proposal_type is None:
                raise ValidationError(
                    f"Unsupported proposal type: {proposal.proposal_type}"
                )
            proposal_type_changed = normalized_proposal_type != proposal.proposal_type
            proposal.status = FamilyAgentProposal.Status.APPROVED
            proposal.proposal_type = normalized_proposal_type
            proposal.approved_by = user
            proposal.approved_at = timezone.now()
            proposal.error_text = ""
            update_fields = [
                "status",
                "approved_by",
                "approved_at",
                "error_text",
                "updated_at",
            ]
            if proposal_type_changed:
                update_fields.append("proposal_type")
            proposal.save(update_fields=update_fields)
            proposal.thread.save(update_fields=["updated_at"])
        commit_family_agent_proposal.delay(str(proposal.id))
        return Response(FamilyAgentProposalSerializer(proposal).data)

    def _lock_proposal(
        self, family: FamilyGroup, proposal_id: str
    ) -> FamilyAgentProposal:
        try:
            return (
                FamilyAgentProposal.objects.select_for_update(of=("self",))
                .select_related("thread")
                .get(id=proposal_id, thread__family=family)
            )
        except FamilyAgentProposal.DoesNotExist as exc:
            raise Http404 from exc

class FamilyAgentMemorySuggestionApproveView(FamilyAgentAccessMixin, APIView):
    def post(self, request: Request, suggestion_id: str) -> Response:
        family = self.get_current_family(request)
        user = cast(User, request.user)
        with transaction.atomic():
            suggestion = self._lock_suggestion(family, suggestion_id)
            if suggestion.status != FamilyAgentMemorySuggestion.Status.PENDING_APPROVAL:
                raise ValidationError(
                    "Memory suggestion is not pending approval and cannot be approved."
                )
            payload = suggestion.proposed_item_json
            if not isinstance(payload, dict):
                raise ValidationError("Memory suggestion payload must be an object.")
            source_ref_json = payload.get("source_ref_json")
            if not isinstance(source_ref_json, dict):
                source_ref_json = {}
            proposed_family_id = payload.get("family_id") or source_ref_json.get(
                "family_id"
            )
            if proposed_family_id and str(proposed_family_id) != str(family.id):
                raise ValidationError(
                    "Only current-family facts can be saved to memory."
                )

            try:
                confidence = float(payload.get("confidence", 0.5))
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                confidence = 0.5

            memory_item = FamilyAgentMemoryItem.objects.create(
                family=family,
                category=payload.get("category", "preference"),
                title=payload.get("title", "Family preference"),
                body=payload.get("body", ""),
                confidence=confidence,
                source_kind=payload.get("source_kind", "agent_suggestion"),
                source_ref_json={
                    "suggestion_id": str(suggestion.id),
                    "run_id": str(suggestion.run_id),
                },
                created_by=user,
                updated_by=user,
            )

            suggestion.status = FamilyAgentMemorySuggestion.Status.APPROVED
            suggestion.approved_by = user
            suggestion.approved_at = timezone.now()
            suggestion.save(
                update_fields=["status", "approved_by", "approved_at", "updated_at"]
            )
            suggestion.thread.save(update_fields=["updated_at"])
        return Response(
            {
                "suggestion": FamilyAgentMemorySuggestionSerializer(suggestion).data,
                "memory_item": FamilyAgentMemoryItemSerializer(memory_item).data,

    upload_result = PrivateMediaStorageService.save_image_attachment(
        file_obj,
        thread_id=str(thread.id),
        message_id=str(message.id),
        display_order=display_order,
    )
    uploaded_keys.extend(
        [
            upload_result.get("object_key"),
            upload_result.get("thumbnail_object_key"),
        ]
    )
    FamilyAgentMessageAttachment.objects.create(
        message=message,
        uploaded_by=uploaded_by,
        kind=FamilyAgentMessageAttachment.Kind.IMAGE,
        storage_alias=str(upload_result["storage_alias"]),
        object_key=str(upload_result["object_key"]),
        thumbnail_object_key=str(upload_result.get("thumbnail_object_key") or ""),
        original_filename=str(upload_result["original_filename"]),
        mime_type=str(upload_result["mime_type"]),
        file_size=int(upload_result["file_size"]),
        width=upload_result.get("width"),
        height=upload_result.get("height"),
        display_order=display_order,
    )


def _attach_linked_capture_photo(
    *,
    family: FamilyGroup,
    context_payload: dict[str, Any],
    thread: FamilyAgentThread,
    message: FamilyAgentMessage,
    uploaded_by: User,
    display_order: int,
    uploaded_keys: list[str | None],
) -> bool:
    capture_id = coerce_uuid(context_payload.get("capture_id"))
    if capture_id is None:
        return False

    capture = (
        InboxCapture.objects.filter(
            id=capture_id,
            family=family,
            capture_type=InboxCapture.CaptureType.PHOTO,
        )
        .only("id", "photo")
        .first()
    )
    if capture is None or not capture.photo:
        return False

    capture.photo.open("rb")
    try:
        _create_message_image_attachment(
            file_obj=capture.photo,
            thread=thread,
            message=message,
            uploaded_by=uploaded_by,
            display_order=display_order,
            uploaded_keys=uploaded_keys,
        )
    finally:
        capture.photo.close()

    return True


def _invalidate_family_agent_threads_cache(family: FamilyGroup) -> None:
    bump_desktop_response_cache_version(
        namespace=FAMILY_AGENT_THREADS_CACHE_NAMESPACE,
        scope_token=family.id,

class FamilyAgentAccessMixin:
    def get_current_family(self, request: Request) -> FamilyGroup:
        user = cast(User, request.user)

        if not family_planner_feature_flags.is_enabled(user):
            raise NotFound("Family planner is not available.")

        family = get_user_immediate_family(user)
        if family is None:
            raise NotFound("Immediate family not found.")

        family = FamilyGroup.objects.select_related("feature_settings").get(
            id=family.id
        )
        if not family.feature_settings.agent_enabled:
            raise NotFound("Family planner is not enabled for this family.")

        has_permission, error_msg = validate_family_admin_permission(
            user,
            family,
            "access family planner",
        )
        if not has_permission and not user.is_staff:
            raise PermissionDenied(
                error_msg or "Only family admins can use the planner."
            )

        return family

    def get_active_threads_queryset(self, family: FamilyGroup) -> Any:
        return FamilyAgentThread.objects.filter(
            family=family,
            is_archived=False,
        ).order_by("-updated_at", "-created_at")

    def get_default_thread(
        self, family: FamilyGroup, *, user: User
    ) -> FamilyAgentThread:
        thread: FamilyAgentThread | None = self.get_active_threads_queryset(
            family
        ).first()
        if thread is not None:
            return thread
        return FamilyAgentThread.objects.create(
            family=family,
            created_by=user,
            title=DEFAULT_FAMILY_AGENT_THREAD_TITLE,
        )

    def get_thread_by_id(
        self, family: FamilyGroup, thread_id: str
    ) -> FamilyAgentThread:
        try:
            return FamilyAgentThread.objects.get(
                id=thread_id,
                family=family,
                is_archived=False,
            )
        except FamilyAgentThread.DoesNotExist as exc:
            raise Http404 from exc

    def resolve_thread(
        self,
        request: Request,
        family: FamilyGroup,
        *,
        user: User,
        thread_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> FamilyAgentThread:
        requested_thread_id = (
            thread_id
            or request.query_params.get("thread_id")
            or request.data.get("thread_id")
        )
        if requested_thread_id:
            return self.get_thread_by_id(family, requested_thread_id)
        return self.get_default_thread(family, user=user)

class FamilyAgentThreadListCreateView(FamilyAgentAccessMixin, APIView):
    def get(self, request: Request) -> Response:
        from django.conf import settings as django_settings

        family = self.get_current_family(request)
        include_archived = (
            str(request.query_params.get("include_archived", "")).lower() == "true"
        )
        cache_scope = f"{family.id}:archived" if include_archived else family.id
        cached_payload = get_desktop_response_cache(
            request,
            namespace=FAMILY_AGENT_THREADS_CACHE_NAMESPACE,
            scope_token=cache_scope,
        )
        if cached_payload is not None:
            return Response(cached_payload)

        user = cast(User, request.user)
        self.get_default_thread(family, user=user)
        if include_archived:
            threads = FamilyAgentThread.objects.filter(family=family).order_by(
                "-updated_at", "-created_at"
            )
        else:
            limit = int(
                getattr(
                    django_settings,
                    "FAMILY_AGENT_THREAD_LIST_DEFAULT_LIMIT",
                    10,
                )
            )
            threads = self.get_active_threads_queryset(family)[:limit]
        serializer = FamilyAgentThreadSerializer(threads, many=True)
        response = Response(serializer.data)
        set_desktop_response_cache(
            request,
            namespace=FAMILY_AGENT_THREADS_CACHE_NAMESPACE,
            scope_token=cache_scope,
            payload=response.data,
        )
        return response

    def post(self, request: Request) -> Response:
        family = self.get_current_family(request)
        user = cast(User, request.user)
        serializer = FamilyAgentThreadCreateSerializer(data=request.data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        thread = FamilyAgentThread.objects.create(
            family=family,
            created_by=user,
            title=serializer.validated_data.get(
                "title",
                DEFAULT_FAMILY_AGENT_THREAD_TITLE,
            ),
        )
        _invalidate_family_agent_threads_cache(family)
        return Response(
            FamilyAgentThreadSerializer(thread).data,
            status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
        )

class FamilyAgentMessageListCreateView(FamilyAgentAccessMixin, APIView):
    pagination_class = PageNumberPagination

    def get(self, request: Request) -> Response:
        family = self.get_current_family(request)
        thread = self.resolve_thread(request, family, user=cast(User, request.user))
        queryset = (
            thread.messages.select_related("author_user", "run")
            .prefetch_related(
                "attachments",
                "triggered_runs",
                "run__proposals",
                "run__memory_suggestions",
            )
            .order_by("-created_at")
        )
        paginator = self.pagination_class()
        page = paginator.paginate_queryset(queryset, request, view=self)
        serializer = FamilyAgentMessageSerializer(
            page,
            many=True,
            context={"request": request},
        )
        return paginator.get_paginated_response(serializer.data)

    def post(self, request: Request) -> Response:
        family = self.get_current_family(request)
        user = cast(User, request.user)

        serializer = FamilyAgentMessageCreateSerializer(data=request.data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        images = serializer.validated_data.get("images", [])
        context_payload = serializer.validated_data.get("context", {}) or {}
        budget_service = FamilyAgentBudgetService()
        capability_flags = budget_service.get_capability_flags(
            family=family,
            user=user,
        )
        uploaded_keys: list[str | None] = []

        capture_id = coerce_uuid(context_payload.get("capture_id"))
        has_linked_capture_photo = bool(
            capture_id
            and InboxCapture.objects.filter(
                id=capture_id,
                family=family,
                capture_type=InboxCapture.CaptureType.PHOTO,
            )
            .exclude(photo="")
            .exists()
        )

        if (images or has_linked_capture_photo) and not capability_flags[
            "image_attachments_enabled"
        ]:
            return _capability_unavailable_response(
                budget_service=budget_service,
                family=family,
                user=user,
                capability="image_attachments",
                message=IMAGE_ATTACHMENTS_UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE,
            )

        estimated_increment_micros = budget_service.estimate_preflight_cost_micros(
            message_text=serializer.validated_data["text"],
            image_count=len(images) + (1 if has_linked_capture_photo else 0),
        )
        try:
            budget_service.enforce_budget(
                family=family,
                user=user,
                estimated_increment_micros=estimated_increment_micros,
            )
        except FamilyAgentBudgetExceeded as exc:
            return _budget_error_response(exc)

        try:
            with transaction.atomic():
                # Serialize enqueue checks per family so parallel clients cannot all
                # pass the pending-run guard before any request creates its run.
                family = FamilyGroup.objects.select_for_update().get(id=family.id)
                if FamilyAgentRun.objects.filter(
                    thread__family=family,
                    status__in=[
                        FamilyAgentRun.Status.PENDING,
                        FamilyAgentRun.Status.RUNNING,
                    ],
                ).exists():
                    return _pending_run_response(
                        budget_service=budget_service,
                        family=family,
                        user=user,
                    )

                try:
                    budget_service.enforce_budget(
                        family=family,
                        user=user,
                        estimated_increment_micros=estimated_increment_micros,
                    )
                except FamilyAgentBudgetExceeded as exc:
                    return _budget_error_response(exc)

                resolution = resolve_effective_thread(
                    family=family,
                    user=user,
                    source_screen=context_payload.get("source_screen"),
                    requested_thread_id=(
                        str(serializer.validated_data["thread_id"])
                        if serializer.validated_data.get("thread_id")
                        else None
                    ),
                )
                thread = resolution.thread
                prior_message_count = thread.messages.count()
                user_message = FamilyAgentMessage.objects.create(
                    thread=thread,
                    author_user=user,
                    role=FamilyAgentMessage.Role.USER,
                    text=serializer.validated_data["text"],
                    status=FamilyAgentMessage.Status.COMPLETED,
                    context_json=context_payload,
                )

                image_attachment_count = 0
                for display_order, image in enumerate(images):
                    _create_message_image_attachment(
                        file_obj=image,
                        thread=thread,
                        message=user_message,
                        uploaded_by=user,
                        display_order=display_order,
                        uploaded_keys=uploaded_keys,
                    )
                    image_attachment_count += 1

                if _attach_linked_capture_photo(
                    family=family,
                    context_payload=context_payload,
                    thread=thread,
                    message=user_message,
                    uploaded_by=user,
                    display_order=image_attachment_count,
                    uploaded_keys=uploaded_keys,
                ):
                    image_attachment_count += 1

                runtime = HermesFamilyPlannerRuntime(
                    external_research_enabled=capability_flags[
                        "external_research_enabled"
                    ],
                )
                run = FamilyAgentRun.objects.create(
                    thread=thread,
                    trigger_message=user_message,
                    status=FamilyAgentRun.Status.PENDING,
                    runtime=runtime.runtime_name,
                    model_name=runtime.model_name,
                )
                user_message.run = run
                user_message.save(update_fields=["run", "updated_at"])
                if (
                    thread.title == DEFAULT_FAMILY_AGENT_THREAD_TITLE
                    and prior_message_count == 0
                    and user_message.text
                ):
                    thread.title = suggest_thread_title(user_message.text)
                    thread.save(update_fields=["title", "updated_at"])
                logger.info(
                    "Family planner queued run_id=%s thread_id=%s family_id=%s user_id=%s trigger_message_id=%s text_length=%s image_count=%s context_keys=%s",
                    run.id,
                    thread.id,
                    family.id,
                    user.id,
                    user_message.id,
                    len(user_message.text),
                    image_attachment_count,
                    sorted((user_message.context_json or {}).keys()),
                )
                thread.save(update_fields=["updated_at"])
        except Exception:
            PrivateMediaStorageService.delete_objects(uploaded_keys)
            raise

        _invalidate_family_agent_threads_cache(family)
        run_family_agent_turn.delay(str(run.id))
        if resolution.split_occurred and resolution.closed_thread_id:
            summarize_thread_for_handoff.delay(
                resolution.closed_thread_id,
                str(thread.id),
            )

        return Response(
            {
                "thread": FamilyAgentThreadSerializer(thread).data,
                "message": FamilyAgentMessageSerializer(
                    user_message,
                    context={"request": request},
                ).data,
                "run": FamilyAgentRunSerializer(run).data,
                "token_pressure": token_pressure(thread.prompt_tokens_estimate),
                "split_occurred": resolution.split_occurred,
                "closed_thread_id": resolution.closed_thread_id,
                "closed_reason": resolution.closed_reason,
            },
            status=status.HTTP_202_ACCEPTED,
        )


class FamilyAgentProposalApproveView(FamilyAgentAccessMixin, APIView):
    def post(self, request: Request, proposal_id: str) -> Response:
        family = self.get_current_family(request)
        user = cast(User, request.user)
        with transaction.atomic():
            proposal = self._lock_proposal(family, proposal_id)
            if proposal.status != FamilyAgentProposal.Status.PENDING_APPROVAL:
                raise ValidationError(
                    "Proposal is not pending approval and cannot be approved."
                )
            normalized_proposal_type = normalize_family_agent_proposal_type(
                proposal.proposal_type
            )
            if normalized_proposal_type is None:
                raise ValidationError(
                    f"Unsupported proposal type: {proposal.proposal_type}"
                )
            proposal_type_changed = normalized_proposal_type != proposal.proposal_type
            proposal.status = FamilyAgentProposal.Status.APPROVED
            proposal.proposal_type = normalized_proposal_type
            proposal.approved_by = user
            proposal.approved_at = timezone.now()
            proposal.error_text = ""
            update_fields = [
                "status",
                "approved_by",
                "approved_at",
                "error_text",
                "updated_at",
            ]
            if proposal_type_changed:
                update_fields.append("proposal_type")
            proposal.save(update_fields=update_fields)
            proposal.thread.save(update_fields=["updated_at"])
        commit_family_agent_proposal.delay(str(proposal.id))
        return Response(FamilyAgentProposalSerializer(proposal).data)

    def _lock_proposal(
        self, family: FamilyGroup, proposal_id: str
    ) -> FamilyAgentProposal:
        try:
            return (
                FamilyAgentProposal.objects.select_for_update(of=("self",))
                .select_related("thread")
                .get(id=proposal_id, thread__family=family)
            )
        except FamilyAgentProposal.DoesNotExist as exc:
            raise Http404 from exc


class FamilyAgentProposalRejectView(FamilyAgentAccessMixin, APIView):

class FamilyAgentMemorySuggestionApproveView(FamilyAgentAccessMixin, APIView):
    def post(self, request: Request, suggestion_id: str) -> Response:
        family = self.get_current_family(request)
        user = cast(User, request.user)
        with transaction.atomic():
            suggestion = self._lock_suggestion(family, suggestion_id)
            if suggestion.status != FamilyAgentMemorySuggestion.Status.PENDING_APPROVAL:
                raise ValidationError(
                    "Memory suggestion is not pending approval and cannot be approved."
                )
            payload = suggestion.proposed_item_json
            if not isinstance(payload, dict):
                raise ValidationError("Memory suggestion payload must be an object.")
            source_ref_json = payload.get("source_ref_json")
            if not isinstance(source_ref_json, dict):
                source_ref_json = {}
            proposed_family_id = payload.get("family_id") or source_ref_json.get(
                "family_id"
            )
            if proposed_family_id and str(proposed_family_id) != str(family.id):
                raise ValidationError(
                    "Only current-family facts can be saved to memory."
                )

            try:
                confidence = float(payload.get("confidence", 0.5))
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                confidence = 0.5

            memory_item = FamilyAgentMemoryItem.objects.create(
                family=family,
                category=payload.get("category", "preference"),
                title=payload.get("title", "Family preference"),
                body=payload.get("body", ""),
                confidence=confidence,
                source_kind=payload.get("source_kind", "agent_suggestion"),
                source_ref_json={
                    "suggestion_id": str(suggestion.id),
                    "run_id": str(suggestion.run_id),
                },
                created_by=user,
                updated_by=user,
            )

            suggestion.status = FamilyAgentMemorySuggestion.Status.APPROVED
            suggestion.approved_by = user
            suggestion.approved_at = timezone.now()
            suggestion.save(
                update_fields=["status", "approved_by", "approved_at", "updated_at"]
            )
            suggestion.thread.save(update_fields=["updated_at"])
        return Response(
            {
                "suggestion": FamilyAgentMemorySuggestionSerializer(suggestion).data,
                "memory_item": FamilyAgentMemoryItemSerializer(memory_item).data,
            }
        )

    def _lock_suggestion(
        self, family: FamilyGroup, suggestion_id: str
    ) -> FamilyAgentMemorySuggestion:
        try:
            return (
                FamilyAgentMemorySuggestion.objects.select_for_update(of=("self",))
                .select_related("thread")
                .get(id=suggestion_id, thread__family=family)
            )
        except FamilyAgentMemorySuggestion.DoesNotExist as exc:
            raise Http404 from exc

    class Meta:
        model = FamilyAgentMessage
        fields = [
            "id",

        read_only_fields = fields

    def _get_resolved_run(self, obj: FamilyAgentMessage) -> FamilyAgentRun | None:
        if obj.run_id is not None:
            return obj.run
        return obj.triggered_runs.order_by("-created_at").first()

    def get_run(self, obj: FamilyAgentMessage) -> str | None:
        run = self._get_resolved_run(obj)
        if run is None:
            return None
        return str(run.id)

    def get_run_status(self, obj: FamilyAgentMessage) -> str | None:
        run = self._get_resolved_run(obj)
        if run is None:
            return None
        return run.status

    def get_run_error_text(self, obj: FamilyAgentMessage) -> str:
        run = self._get_resolved_run(obj)
        if run is None:
            return ""
        return run.error_text

    def get_proposals(self, obj: FamilyAgentMessage) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        if obj.run_id is None or obj.run is None:
            return []
        proposals = obj.run.proposals.all().order_by("created_at")
        return list(FamilyAgentProposalSerializer(proposals, many=True).data)

    def get_memory_suggestions(self, obj: FamilyAgentMessage) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        if obj.run_id is None or obj.run is None:
            return []
        suggestions = obj.run.memory_suggestions.all().order_by("created_at")
        return list(FamilyAgentMemorySuggestionSerializer(suggestions, many=True).data)

    def get_action_suggestions(self, obj: FamilyAgentMessage) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        if not isinstance(obj.action_suggestions_json, list):
            return []
        return obj.action_suggestions_json

    def get_entity_links(self, obj: FamilyAgentMessage) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
        if not isinstance(obj.context_json, dict):
            return []
        return normalize_entity_links(obj.context_json.get("entity_links"))

def _sanitize_user_location(value: object) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """Return a whitelisted user_location dict or None if invalid/stale.

    Silently drops unexpected keys and out-of-range coordinates instead of
    raising so arbitrary client JSON never reaches the agent prompt.
    """
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return None
    try:
        latitude = float(value.get("latitude"))  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        longitude = float(value.get("longitude"))  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None
    if not (-90.0 <= latitude <= 90.0) or not (-180.0 <= longitude <= 180.0):
        return None

    accuracy_raw = value.get("accuracy_m")
    accuracy_m: float | None
    if accuracy_raw in (None, ""):
        accuracy_m = None
    else:
        try:
            accuracy_m = float(accuracy_raw)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            accuracy_m = None
        else:
            if accuracy_m < 0:
                accuracy_m = None

    captured_at_raw = value.get("captured_at")
    if not isinstance(captured_at_raw, str) or not captured_at_raw.strip():
        return None
    try:
        captured_at = datetime.fromisoformat(captured_at_raw.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    except ValueError:
        return None
    if captured_at.tzinfo is None:
        captured_at = captured_at.replace(tzinfo=dt_timezone.utc)
    now = datetime.now(dt_timezone.utc)
    if now - captured_at > USER_LOCATION_MAX_AGE:
        logger.info(
            "Dropping stale user_location in family agent context (age=%s)",
            now - captured_at,
        )
        return None

    return {
        "latitude": latitude,
        "longitude": longitude,
        "accuracy_m": accuracy_m,
        "captured_at": captured_at.astimezone(dt_timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    }

"""
Utilities for extracting metadata from ICS calendar files
"""

import logging
import re
from collections import Counter
from typing import Any
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlparse

import requests
from icalendar import Calendar

from core.url_validation import is_allowed_hostname, validate_outbound_url

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

MAX_ICS_BYTES = 5_000_000
MAX_REDIRECTS = 3
REDIRECT_STATUS_CODES = {301, 302, 303, 307, 308}
ALLOWED_CONTENT_TYPE_HINTS = (
    "text/calendar",
    "text/plain",
    "application/octet-stream",
    "application/ics",
    "application/x-ical",
    "text/x-vcalendar",
)


def normalize_and_validate_ics_url(ics_url: str) -> str | None:
    """
    Normalize and validate an ICS URL against outbound request safety rules.

    Handles the ICS-specific ``webcal://`` scheme, then delegates
    standard SSRF checks to :func:`core.url_validation.validate_outbound_url`.

    Returns:
        Normalized URL when safe to fetch, otherwise None.
    """
    candidate = ics_url.strip()
    if not candidate:
        return None

    if candidate.lower().startswith("webcal://"):
        candidate = "https://" + candidate[9:]

    return validate_outbound_url(candidate)


def _build_redirect_target(current_url: str, response: requests.Response) -> str | None:
    if response.status_code not in REDIRECT_STATUS_CODES:
        return None
    location = response.headers.get("Location")
    if not location:
        logger.warning("Blocked redirect without Location header for ICS URL")
        return None
    return urljoin(current_url, location)


def _request_with_redirect_guard(
    *,
    method: str,
    initial_url: str,
    timeout: int,
    stream: bool = False,
    headers: dict[str, str] | None = None,
) -> requests.Response | None:
    current_url = initial_url

    for _ in range(MAX_REDIRECTS + 1):
        safe_url = normalize_and_validate_ics_url(current_url)
        if safe_url is None:
            return None

        # Re-validate DNS just before request to narrow TOCTOU window
        parsed = urlparse(safe_url)
        if parsed.hostname and not is_allowed_hostname(parsed.hostname):

class PlannerUserFacingError(RuntimeError):
    """Raised to surface a safe, user-facing message via error_text."""


def _normalize_proposal_payload(payload: Any) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return None

    normalized_proposal_type = normalize_family_agent_proposal_type(
        payload.get("proposal_type")
    )
    if normalized_proposal_type is None:
        return None

    for key in REQUIRED_PROPOSAL_TEXT_KEYS:
        value = payload.get(key)
        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
            return None

    normalized_payload = dict(payload)
    normalized_payload["proposal_type"] = normalized_proposal_type
    return normalized_payload


def _touch_thread(run: FamilyAgentRun) -> None:
    thread = run.thread

def _assistant_text_claims_existing_approval(assistant_text: str) -> bool:
    normalized_text = assistant_text.strip()
    if not normalized_text:
        return False

    claim_patterns = (
        r"\b(?:i|we)(?:'ve| have)?\s+(?:prepared|created|drafted|put together)\b.{0,120}\b(?:proposal|draft)\b",
        r"\bpending\s+(?:your\s+)?(?:final\s+)?approval\b",
        r"\bready\s+(?:for|to)\s+approval\b",
        r"\bonce you approve this\b",
        r"\bapprove this\b",
    )

    return any(
        re.search(pattern, normalized_text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
        for pattern in claim_patterns
    )


def _runtime_usage_json_from_error(exc: Exception) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if isinstance(exc, FamilyAgentRuntimeUsageError):
        return exc.usage_json
    return {}


def _usage_int(usage_json: dict[str, Any], key: str) -> int:
    try:
        return max(0, int(usage_json.get(key) or 0))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return 0


def _tool_call_count(usage_json: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
    calls = usage_json.get("availability_tool_calls")
    return len(calls) if isinstance(calls, list) else 0

    if isinstance(exc, PlannerUserFacingError):
        return str(exc)
    if isinstance(exc, FamilyAgentRuntimeUsageError) and isinstance(
        exc.__cause__, FamilyAgentBudgetExceeded
    ):
        return str(

        )
    return GENERIC_RUN_ERROR_TEXT

    if not isinstance(payload, dict):

    if normalized_proposal_type is None:

    for key in REQUIRED_PROPOSAL_TEXT_KEYS:

    normalized_payload["proposal_type"] = normalized_proposal_type

def _assistant_text_claims_existing_approval(assistant_text: str) -> bool:
    normalized_text = assistant_text.strip()
    if not normalized_text:
        return False

    claim_patterns = (
        r"\b(?:i|we)(?:'ve| have)?\s+(?:prepared|created|drafted|put together)\b.{0,120}\b(?:proposal|draft)\b",
        r"\bpending\s+(?:your\s+)?(?:final\s+)?approval\b",
        r"\bready\s+(?:for|to)\s+approval\b",
        r"\bonce you approve this\b",

class PlannerUserFacingError(RuntimeError):
    """Raised to surface a safe, user-facing message via error_text."""


def _normalize_proposal_payload(payload: Any) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return None

    normalized_proposal_type = normalize_family_agent_proposal_type(
        payload.get("proposal_type")
    )
    if normalized_proposal_type is None:
        return None

    for key in REQUIRED_PROPOSAL_TEXT_KEYS:
        value = payload.get(key)
        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
            return None

    normalized_payload = dict(payload)
    normalized_payload["proposal_type"] = normalized_proposal_type
    return normalized_payload


def _touch_thread(run: FamilyAgentRun) -> None:
    thread = run.thread
    thread.save(update_fields=["updated_at"])

        return
    thread = run.thread
    FamilyAgentThread.objects.filter(pk=thread.pk).update(
        prompt_tokens_estimate=models_F("prompt_tokens_estimate") + increment,
    )


def _assistant_text_claims_existing_approval(assistant_text: str) -> bool:
    normalized_text = assistant_text.strip()
    if not normalized_text:
        return False

    claim_patterns = (
        r"\b(?:i|we)(?:'ve| have)?\s+(?:prepared|created|drafted|put together)\b.{0,120}\b(?:proposal|draft)\b",
        r"\bpending\s+(?:your\s+)?(?:final\s+)?approval\b",
        r"\bready\s+(?:for|to)\s+approval\b",
        r"\bonce you approve this\b",
        r"\bapprove this\b",
    )

    return any(
        re.search(pattern, normalized_text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
        for pattern in claim_patterns
    )


def _runtime_usage_json_from_error(exc: Exception) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if isinstance(exc, FamilyAgentRuntimeUsageError):
        return exc.usage_json
    return {}


def _usage_int(usage_json: dict[str, Any], key: str) -> int:
    try:
        return max(0, int(usage_json.get(key) or 0))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return 0


def _tool_call_count(usage_json: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
    calls = usage_json.get("availability_tool_calls")
    return len(calls) if isinstance(calls, list) else 0

    if isinstance(exc, PlannerUserFacingError):
        return str(exc)
    if isinstance(exc, FamilyAgentRuntimeUsageError) and isinstance(
        exc.__cause__, FamilyAgentBudgetExceeded
    ):
        return str(
            exc.__cause__.public_payload.get("message") or GENERIC_RUN_ERROR_TEXT
        )
    return GENERIC_RUN_ERROR_TEXT

def commit_family_agent_proposal(self: Any, proposal_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        with transaction.atomic():
            try:
                proposal = (
                    FamilyAgentProposal.objects.select_for_update(of=("self",))
                    .select_related("thread__family", "approved_by")
                    .get(id=proposal_id)
                )
            except FamilyAgentProposal.DoesNotExist:
                logger.warning("Proposal %s not found during commit", proposal_id)
                return {"status": "not_found", "proposal_id": proposal_id}

            if proposal.status != FamilyAgentProposal.Status.APPROVED:
                return {"status": proposal.status, "proposal_id": str(proposal.id)}

            if proposal.approved_by is None:
                raise ValueError("Approved proposals require an approving user.")

            normalized_proposal_type = normalize_family_agent_proposal_type(
                proposal.proposal_type
            )
            if normalized_proposal_type is None:
                raise ValueError(f"Unsupported proposal type: {proposal.proposal_type}")
            if normalized_proposal_type != proposal.proposal_type:
                proposal.proposal_type = normalized_proposal_type
                proposal.save(update_fields=["proposal_type", "updated_at"])

            adapter = FamilyPlannerToolAdapter()
            result_ref = adapter.commit_approved_proposal(
                proposal,
                approved_by=proposal.approved_by,
            )
            proposal.status = FamilyAgentProposal.Status.COMMITTED
            proposal.result_ref_json = result_ref
            proposal.error_text = ""
            proposal.save(
                update_fields=[
                    "status",
                    "result_ref_json",
                    "error_text",
                    "updated_at",
                ]
            )
            proposal.thread.save(update_fields=["updated_at"])
            return {"status": proposal.status, "proposal_id": str(proposal.id)}
    except Exception:
        logger.exception("Family planner proposal %s failed to commit", proposal_id)
        updated = FamilyAgentProposal.objects.filter(
            id=proposal_id,
            status=FamilyAgentProposal.Status.APPROVED,
        ).update(
            status=FamilyAgentProposal.Status.FAILED,
            error_text=GENERIC_COMMIT_ERROR_TEXT,
            updated_at=timezone.now(),
        )
        if updated:
            failed = FamilyAgentProposal.objects.filter(id=proposal_id).first()
            if failed is not None:
                failed.thread.save(update_fields=["updated_at"])
        raise

)

from family_agent.models import (

    FamilyAgentMessage,
    FamilyAgentProposal,
    FamilyAgentRun,

    FamilyAgentUsageEvent,
)
from family_agent.proposal_types import normalize_family_agent_proposal_type
from family_agent.runtime import (
    FamilyAgentRuntimeUsageError,
    HermesFamilyPlannerRuntime,
)
from family_agent.tool_adapter import FamilyPlannerToolAdapter

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

GENERIC_RUN_ERROR_TEXT = "Planner run failed. Please try again."
GENERIC_COMMIT_ERROR_TEXT = "Unable to commit proposal. Please try again."
APPROVAL_CARD_ERROR_TEXT = "Planner couldn't create an approval card. Please try again."
REQUIRED_PROPOSAL_TEXT_KEYS = ("summary", "preview_text")


class PlannerUserFacingError(RuntimeError):
    """Raised to surface a safe, user-facing message via error_text."""


def _normalize_proposal_payload(payload: Any) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return None

    normalized_proposal_type = normalize_family_agent_proposal_type(
        payload.get("proposal_type")
    )
    if normalized_proposal_type is None:
        return None

    for key in REQUIRED_PROPOSAL_TEXT_KEYS:
        value = payload.get(key)
        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
            return None

    normalized_payload = dict(payload)
    normalized_payload["proposal_type"] = normalized_proposal_type
    return normalized_payload


def _touch_thread(run: FamilyAgentRun) -> None:
    thread = run.thread
    thread.save(update_fields=["updated_at"])


def _accumulate_thread_token_estimate(run: FamilyAgentRun, increment: int) -> None:
    if increment <= 0:
        return
    thread = run.thread
    FamilyAgentThread.objects.filter(pk=thread.pk).update(
        prompt_tokens_estimate=django_db_models.F("prompt_tokens_estimate") + increment,
    )


def _assistant_text_claims_existing_approval(assistant_text: str) -> bool:
    normalized_text = assistant_text.strip()
    if not normalized_text:
        return False

    claim_patterns = (
        r"\b(?:i|we)(?:'ve| have)?\s+(?:prepared|created|drafted|put together)\b.{0,120}\b(?:proposal|draft)\b",
        r"\bpending\s+(?:your\s+)?(?:final\s+)?approval\b",
        r"\bready\s+(?:for|to)\s+approval\b",
        r"\bonce you approve this\b",
        r"\bapprove this\b",
    )

    return any(
        re.search(pattern, normalized_text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
        for pattern in claim_patterns
    )


def _runtime_usage_json_from_error(exc: Exception) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if isinstance(exc, FamilyAgentRuntimeUsageError):
        return exc.usage_json
    return {}


def _usage_int(usage_json: dict[str, Any], key: str) -> int:
    try:
        return max(0, int(usage_json.get(key) or 0))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return 0


def _tool_call_count(usage_json: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
    calls = usage_json.get("availability_tool_calls")
    return len(calls) if isinstance(calls, list) else 0


def _run_error_text(exc: Exception) -> str:
    if isinstance(exc, PlannerUserFacingError):
        return str(exc)
    if isinstance(exc, FamilyAgentRuntimeUsageError) and isinstance(
        exc.__cause__, FamilyAgentBudgetExceeded
    ):
        return str(
            exc.__cause__.public_payload.get("message") or GENERIC_RUN_ERROR_TEXT
        )
    return GENERIC_RUN_ERROR_TEXT

    bind=True,
    max_retries=2,
    default_retry_delay=30,
    autoretry_for=(Exception,),
    retry_backoff=True,
)
def run_family_agent_turn(self: Any, run_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    run = FamilyAgentRun.objects.select_related(
        "thread__family",
        "trigger_message__author_user",
    ).get(id=run_id)
    run.status = FamilyAgentRun.Status.RUNNING
    run.started_at = timezone.now()
    run.runtime = HermesFamilyPlannerRuntime.runtime_name
    run.save(update_fields=["status", "started_at", "runtime", "updated_at"])

    trigger_message = run.trigger_message
    if trigger_message is None or trigger_message.author_user is None:
        raise ValueError("Planner runs require a user-authored trigger message.")

    logger.info(
        "Family planner task started run_id=%s celery_task_id=%s thread_id=%s family_id=%s user_id=%s trigger_message_id=%s",
        run.id,
        getattr(self.request, "id", None),
        run.thread.id,
        run.thread.family.id,
        trigger_message.author_user.id,
        trigger_message.id,
    )
    budget_service = FamilyAgentBudgetService()
    capability_flags = budget_service.get_capability_flags(
        family=run.thread.family,
        user=trigger_message.author_user,
    )
    runtime = HermesFamilyPlannerRuntime(
        external_research_enabled=capability_flags["external_research_enabled"],
        budget_service=budget_service,
    )

    attachment_count = trigger_message.attachments.count()
    preflight_estimate_micros = budget_service.estimate_preflight_cost_micros(
        message_text=trigger_message.text,
        image_count=attachment_count,
    )

    try:
        try:
            budget_service.enforce_budget(
                family=run.thread.family,
                user=trigger_message.author_user,
                estimated_increment_micros=preflight_estimate_micros,
            )
        except FamilyAgentBudgetExceeded as exc:
            run.status = FamilyAgentRun.Status.FAILED
            run.finished_at = timezone.now()
            run.error_text = str(exc.public_payload.get("message") or "")
            run.model_name = runtime.model_name
            run.save(
                update_fields=[
                    "status",
                    "finished_at",
                    "error_text",
                    "model_name",

        normalized_action_suggestions = coerce_for_json(

        normalized_entity_links = normalize_entity_links(

        raw_proposals_value = result.get("proposals") or []
        if isinstance(raw_proposals_value, list):

        normalized_memory_suggestions = [

        normalized_usage = coerce_for_json(result.get("usage_json") or {})

            except FamilyAgentProposal.DoesNotExist:
                logger.warning("Proposal %s not found during commit", proposal_id)
                return {"status": "not_found", "proposal_id": proposal_id}

            if proposal.status != FamilyAgentProposal.Status.APPROVED:
                return {"status": proposal.status, "proposal_id": str(proposal.id)}

            if proposal.approved_by is None:
                raise ValueError("Approved proposals require an approving user.")

            normalized_proposal_type = normalize_family_agent_proposal_type(
                proposal.proposal_type

            if normalized_proposal_type is None:
                raise ValueError(f"Unsupported proposal type: {proposal.proposal_type}")
            if normalized_proposal_type != proposal.proposal_type:
                proposal.proposal_type = normalized_proposal_type
                proposal.save(update_fields=["proposal_type", "updated_at"])

            adapter = FamilyPlannerToolAdapter()
            result_ref = adapter.commit_approved_proposal(
                proposal,

            proposal.result_ref_json = result_ref
            proposal.error_text = ""
            proposal.save(
                update_fields=[

                    "result_ref_json",
                    "error_text",
                    "updated_at",
                ]
            )
            proposal.thread.save(update_fields=["updated_at"])

            status=FamilyAgentProposal.Status.FAILED,
            error_text=GENERIC_COMMIT_ERROR_TEXT,
            updated_at=timezone.now(),

            if failed is not None:

@shared_task
def summarize_thread_for_handoff(
    closed_thread_id: str,
    continuation_thread_id: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    closed_thread = FamilyAgentThread.objects.filter(id=closed_thread_id).first()
    continuation_thread = FamilyAgentThread.objects.filter(
        id=continuation_thread_id,
    ).first()
    if closed_thread is None or continuation_thread is None:
        logger.warning(
            "Skipping family planner handoff summary closed_thread_id=%s continuation_thread_id=%s missing_closed=%s missing_continuation=%s",
            closed_thread_id,
            continuation_thread_id,
            closed_thread is None,
            continuation_thread is None,
        )
        return {
            "status": "missing_thread",
            "closed_thread_id": closed_thread_id,
            "continuation_thread_id": continuation_thread_id,
        }

    messages = list(
        FamilyAgentMessage.objects.filter(
            thread=closed_thread,
            role__in=[
                FamilyAgentMessage.Role.USER,
                FamilyAgentMessage.Role.ASSISTANT,
            ],
        ).order_by("-created_at")[:HANDOFF_SUMMARY_MESSAGE_LIMIT]
    )
    messages.reverse()
    summary_text = "\n".join(_handoff_message_excerpt(message) for message in messages)
    if len(summary_text) > HANDOFF_SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS:
        summary_text = f"{summary_text[: HANDOFF_SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS - 3]}..."

    now = timezone.now()
    with transaction.atomic():
        FamilyAgentThread.objects.filter(pk=closed_thread.pk).update(
            summary_text=summary_text,
            updated_at=now,
        )
        FamilyAgentThread.objects.filter(pk=continuation_thread.pk).update(
            summary_text=summary_text,
            updated_at=now,
        )

    logger.info(
        "Family planner handoff summary saved closed_thread_id=%s continuation_thread_id=%s message_count=%s summary_length=%s",
        closed_thread.id,
        continuation_thread.id,
        len(messages),
        len(summary_text),
    )
    return {
        "status": "completed",
        "closed_thread_id": str(closed_thread.id),
        "continuation_thread_id": str(continuation_thread.id),
        "message_count": len(messages),
        "summary_length": len(summary_text),
    }

import logging
import re
from typing import Any

from celery import shared_task
from django.db import models as django_db_models
from django.db import transaction
from django.utils import timezone

from family_agent.attachment_vision import FamilyPlannerAttachmentVisionService
from family_agent.budget import FamilyAgentBudgetExceeded, FamilyAgentBudgetService
from family_agent.entity_links import normalize_entity_links
from family_agent.inline_refs import (
    collapse_inline_ref_label_duplicates,
    convert_known_markdown_links_to_refs,
    ensure_inline_refs_for_entity_mentions,
    expand_inline_refs,
    strip_unresolved_ref_markers,
)
from family_agent.json_utils import coerce_for_json, validate_json_payload
from family_agent.models import (
    FamilyAgentMemorySuggestion,
    FamilyAgentMessage,
    FamilyAgentProposal,
    FamilyAgentRun,
    FamilyAgentThread,
    FamilyAgentUsageEvent,
)
from family_agent.proposal_types import normalize_family_agent_proposal_type
from family_agent.runtime import (
    FamilyAgentRuntimeUsageError,
    HermesFamilyPlannerRuntime,
)
from family_agent.tool_adapter import FamilyPlannerToolAdapter

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

GENERIC_RUN_ERROR_TEXT = "Planner run failed. Please try again."
GENERIC_COMMIT_ERROR_TEXT = "Unable to commit proposal. Please try again."
APPROVAL_CARD_ERROR_TEXT = "Planner couldn't create an approval card. Please try again."
REQUIRED_PROPOSAL_TEXT_KEYS = ("summary", "preview_text")
HANDOFF_SUMMARY_MESSAGE_LIMIT = 8
HANDOFF_SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS = 4000
HANDOFF_MESSAGE_MAX_CHARS = 500


class PlannerUserFacingError(RuntimeError):
    """Raised to surface a safe, user-facing message via error_text."""


def _normalize_proposal_payload(payload: Any) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return None

    normalized_proposal_type = normalize_family_agent_proposal_type(
        payload.get("proposal_type")
    )
    if normalized_proposal_type is None:
        return None

    for key in REQUIRED_PROPOSAL_TEXT_KEYS:
        value = payload.get(key)
        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
            return None

    normalized_payload = dict(payload)
    normalized_payload["proposal_type"] = normalized_proposal_type
    return normalized_payload


def _touch_thread(run: FamilyAgentRun) -> None:
    thread = run.thread
    thread.save(update_fields=["updated_at"])


def _accumulate_thread_token_estimate(run: FamilyAgentRun, increment: int) -> None:
    if increment <= 0:
        return
    thread = run.thread
    FamilyAgentThread.objects.filter(pk=thread.pk).update(
        prompt_tokens_estimate=django_db_models.F("prompt_tokens_estimate") + increment,
    )


def _assistant_text_claims_existing_approval(assistant_text: str) -> bool:
    normalized_text = assistant_text.strip()
    if not normalized_text:
        return False

    claim_patterns = (
        r"\b(?:i|we)(?:'ve| have)?\s+(?:prepared|created|drafted|put together)\b.{0,120}\b(?:proposal|draft)\b",
        r"\bpending\s+(?:your\s+)?(?:final\s+)?approval\b",
        r"\bready\s+(?:for|to)\s+approval\b",
        r"\bonce you approve this\b",
        r"\bapprove this\b",
    )

    return any(
        re.search(pattern, normalized_text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
        for pattern in claim_patterns
    )


def _runtime_usage_json_from_error(exc: Exception) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if isinstance(exc, FamilyAgentRuntimeUsageError):
        return exc.usage_json
    return {}


def _usage_int(usage_json: dict[str, Any], key: str) -> int:
    try:
        return max(0, int(usage_json.get(key) or 0))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return 0


def _tool_call_count(usage_json: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
    calls = usage_json.get("availability_tool_calls")
    return len(calls) if isinstance(calls, list) else 0


def _handoff_message_excerpt(message: FamilyAgentMessage) -> str:
    author = "You" if message.role == FamilyAgentMessage.Role.USER else "Clancy"
    text = " ".join((message.text or "").split())
    if len(text) > HANDOFF_MESSAGE_MAX_CHARS:
        text = f"{text[: HANDOFF_MESSAGE_MAX_CHARS - 3]}..."
    if not text:
        text = "[no visible text]"
    return f"{author}: {text}"


def _run_error_text(exc: Exception) -> str:
    if isinstance(exc, PlannerUserFacingError):
        return str(exc)
    if isinstance(exc, FamilyAgentRuntimeUsageError) and isinstance(
        exc.__cause__, FamilyAgentBudgetExceeded
    ):
        return str(
            exc.__cause__.public_payload.get("message") or GENERIC_RUN_ERROR_TEXT
        )
    return GENERIC_RUN_ERROR_TEXT


@shared_task(
    bind=True,
    max_retries=2,
    default_retry_delay=30,
    autoretry_for=(Exception,),
    retry_backoff=True,
)
def run_family_agent_turn(self: Any, run_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    run = FamilyAgentRun.objects.select_related(
        "thread__family",
        "trigger_message__author_user",
    ).get(id=run_id)
    run.status = FamilyAgentRun.Status.RUNNING
    run.started_at = timezone.now()
    run.runtime = HermesFamilyPlannerRuntime.runtime_name
    run.save(update_fields=["status", "started_at", "runtime", "updated_at"])

    trigger_message = run.trigger_message
    if trigger_message is None or trigger_message.author_user is None:
        raise ValueError("Planner runs require a user-authored trigger message.")

    logger.info(
        "Family planner task started run_id=%s celery_task_id=%s thread_id=%s family_id=%s user_id=%s trigger_message_id=%s",
        run.id,
        getattr(self.request, "id", None),
        run.thread.id,
        run.thread.family.id,
        trigger_message.author_user.id,
        trigger_message.id,
