@shared_task
def summarize_thread_for_handoff(
    closed_thread_id: str,
    continuation_thread_id: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    closed_thread = FamilyAgentThread.objects.filter(id=closed_thread_id).first()
    continuation_thread = FamilyAgentThread.objects.filter(
        id=continuation_thread_id,
    ).first()
    if closed_thread is None or continuation_thread is None:
        logger.warning(
            "Skipping family planner handoff summary closed_thread_id=%s continuation_thread_id=%s missing_closed=%s missing_continuation=%s",
            closed_thread_id,
            continuation_thread_id,
            closed_thread is None,
            continuation_thread is None,
        )
        return {
            "status": "missing_thread",
            "closed_thread_id": closed_thread_id,
            "continuation_thread_id": continuation_thread_id,
        }

    messages = list(
        FamilyAgentMessage.objects.filter(
            thread=closed_thread,
            role__in=[
                FamilyAgentMessage.Role.USER,
                FamilyAgentMessage.Role.ASSISTANT,
            ],
        ).order_by("-created_at")[:HANDOFF_SUMMARY_MESSAGE_LIMIT]
    )
    messages.reverse()
    summary_text = "\n".join(_handoff_message_excerpt(message) for message in messages)
    if len(summary_text) > HANDOFF_SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS:
        summary_text = f"{summary_text[: HANDOFF_SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS - 3]}..."

    now = timezone.now()
    with transaction.atomic():
        FamilyAgentThread.objects.filter(pk=closed_thread.pk).update(
            summary_text=summary_text,
            updated_at=now,
        )
        FamilyAgentThread.objects.filter(pk=continuation_thread.pk).update(
            summary_text=summary_text,
            updated_at=now,
        )

    logger.info(
        "Family planner handoff summary saved closed_thread_id=%s continuation_thread_id=%s message_count=%s summary_length=%s",
        closed_thread.id,
        continuation_thread.id,
        len(messages),
        len(summary_text),
    )
    return {
        "status": "completed",
        "closed_thread_id": str(closed_thread.id),
        "continuation_thread_id": str(continuation_thread.id),
        "message_count": len(messages),
        "summary_length": len(summary_text),
    }


@shared_task(bind=True)
def commit_family_agent_proposal(self: Any, proposal_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        with transaction.atomic():
            try:
                proposal = (
                    FamilyAgentProposal.objects.select_for_update(of=("self",))
                    .select_related("thread__family", "approved_by")
                    .get(id=proposal_id)
                )
            except FamilyAgentProposal.DoesNotExist:
                logger.warning("Proposal %s not found during commit", proposal_id)
                return {"status": "not_found", "proposal_id": proposal_id}

            if proposal.status != FamilyAgentProposal.Status.APPROVED:
                return {"status": proposal.status, "proposal_id": str(proposal.id)}

            if proposal.approved_by is None:
                raise ValueError("Approved proposals require an approving user.")

            normalized_proposal_type = normalize_family_agent_proposal_type(
                proposal.proposal_type
            )
            if normalized_proposal_type is None:
                raise ValueError(f"Unsupported proposal type: {proposal.proposal_type}")
            if normalized_proposal_type != proposal.proposal_type:
                proposal.proposal_type = normalized_proposal_type
                proposal.save(update_fields=["proposal_type", "updated_at"])

            adapter = FamilyPlannerToolAdapter()
            result_ref = adapter.commit_approved_proposal(
                proposal,
                approved_by=proposal.approved_by,
            )
            proposal.status = FamilyAgentProposal.Status.COMMITTED
            proposal.result_ref_json = result_ref
            proposal.error_text = ""
            proposal.save(
                update_fields=[
                    "status",
                    "result_ref_json",
                    "error_text",
                    "updated_at",
                ]
            )
            proposal.thread.save(update_fields=["updated_at"])
            return {"status": proposal.status, "proposal_id": str(proposal.id)}
    except Exception:
        logger.exception("Family planner proposal %s failed to commit", proposal_id)
        updated = FamilyAgentProposal.objects.filter(
            id=proposal_id,
            status=FamilyAgentProposal.Status.APPROVED,
        ).update(
            status=FamilyAgentProposal.Status.FAILED,
            error_text=GENERIC_COMMIT_ERROR_TEXT,
            updated_at=timezone.now(),
        )
        if updated:
            failed = FamilyAgentProposal.objects.filter(id=proposal_id).first()
            if failed is not None:
                failed.thread.save(update_fields=["updated_at"])
        raise


def _build_handoff_transcript(thread: FamilyAgentThread) -> str:
    messages = list(
        thread.messages.order_by("-created_at")[:HANDOFF_SUMMARY_MESSAGE_LIMIT]
    )
    messages.reverse()
    excerpts = [_handoff_message_excerpt(m) for m in messages if m.text or m.role]
    return "\n".join(excerpts)


def _generate_handoff_summary(transcript: str) -> str:
    if not transcript.strip():
        return ""
    from family_scheduler.ai_client import AIClient, get_workload_model

    client = AIClient()
    try:
        model = get_workload_model("text_fast")
    except Exception:
        logger.warning("Handoff summary skipped: text_fast model not configured.")
        return ""
    system_prompt = (
        "You summarize a family-assistant conversation in 2-3 short sentences. "
        "Focus on unresolved asks and named entities (events, trips, people). "
        "Be terse and concrete. Do not add greetings or apologies."
    )
    try:
        response = client.chat.completions.create(
            model=model,
            messages=[
                {"role": "system", "content": system_prompt},
                {"role": "user", "content": transcript},
            ],
            max_tokens=200,
            temperature=0.2,
        )
    except Exception:
        logger.exception("Handoff summary LLM call failed.")
        return ""
    try:
        text = response.choices[0].message.content or ""
    except (AttributeError, IndexError, KeyError):
        return ""
    text = text.strip()
    if len(text) > HANDOFF_SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS:
        text = text[: HANDOFF_SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS - 3] + "..."
    return text


@shared_task(
    bind=True,
    max_retries=2,
    default_retry_delay=10,
    autoretry_for=(Exception,),
    retry_backoff=True,
)
def summarize_thread_for_handoff(
    self: Any, closed_thread_id: str, new_thread_id: str
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        closed = FamilyAgentThread.objects.get(id=closed_thread_id)
        new_thread = FamilyAgentThread.objects.get(id=new_thread_id)
    except FamilyAgentThread.DoesNotExist:
        logger.warning(
            "Handoff summary skipped: missing thread closed=%s new=%s",
            closed_thread_id,
            new_thread_id,
        )
        return {"status": "skipped"}

    transcript = _build_handoff_transcript(closed)
    summary = _generate_handoff_summary(transcript)
    if not summary:
        return {"status": "no_summary"}

    with transaction.atomic():
        closed.summary_text = summary
        closed.save(update_fields=["summary_text", "updated_at"])
        FamilyAgentMessage.objects.create(
            thread=new_thread,
            author_user=None,
            role=FamilyAgentMessage.Role.SYSTEM,
            text=f"[Continued from prior thread] {summary}",
            status=FamilyAgentMessage.Status.COMPLETED,
        )
        new_thread.save(update_fields=["updated_at"])

    return {"status": "ok", "summary_chars": len(summary)}

class HermesFamilyPlannerRuntime:
    runtime_name = "hermes"
    availability_tool_iteration_limit = 6

    def __init__(
        self,
        tool_adapter: FamilyPlannerToolAdapter | None = None,
        *,
        external_research_enabled: bool = True,
        budget_service: FamilyAgentBudgetService | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.tool_adapter = tool_adapter or FamilyPlannerToolAdapter()
        self.external_research_enabled = external_research_enabled
        self.budget_service = budget_service or FamilyAgentBudgetService()
        explicit_model = getattr(settings, "FAMILY_AGENT_HERMES_MODEL", "").strip()
        proxy_base_url = getattr(settings, "LITELLM_PROXY_BASE_URL", "").strip()
        # Only route to the LiteLLM proxy when we are using the default proxy
        # alias (no explicit model) AND the proxy URL is configured. An
        # explicit model must never use the proxy branch, otherwise the
        # provider's API key would be sent to the internal proxy URL.
        self._using_proxy_default = bool(proxy_base_url) and not explicit_model
        self.model_name = self._resolve_model_name()
        self.provider = self._resolve_provider()
        self.agent_model_name = self._normalize_model_name_for_provider()
        self.base_url = self._resolve_base_url()
        self.hermes_provider = self._resolve_hermes_provider()
        self.api_key, self.api_key_setting_name = self._resolve_api_key()
        self.max_iterations = int(
            getattr(settings, "FAMILY_AGENT_HERMES_MAX_ITERATIONS", 10)
        )

    def _resolve_model_name(self) -> str:
        configured_model = getattr(settings, "FAMILY_AGENT_HERMES_MODEL", "").strip()
        if configured_model:
            return configured_model
        if self._using_proxy_default:
            return _DEFAULT_PLANNER_PROXY_MODEL
        configured_provider = getattr(
            settings, "FAMILY_AGENT_HERMES_PROVIDER", ""
        ).strip()
        if configured_provider:
            normalized_provider = configured_provider.lower()
            if normalized_provider == "gemini":
                return _DEFAULT_PLANNER_DIRECT_MODEL
            if normalized_provider == "openai":
                return "openai/gpt-5.4-mini"
            if normalized_provider == "anthropic":
                return "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4"
        return _DEFAULT_PLANNER_DIRECT_MODEL

    def _should_use_litellm_proxy(self) -> bool:
        proxy_base_url = getattr(settings, "LITELLM_PROXY_BASE_URL", "").strip()
        explicit_base_url = getattr(
            settings, "FAMILY_AGENT_HERMES_BASE_URL", ""
        ).strip()
        if not proxy_base_url or explicit_base_url:
            return False
        return self._using_proxy_default or (
            self.model_name.strip().lower() == _DEFAULT_PLANNER_PROXY_MODEL.lower()
        )

    def _resolve_provider(self) -> str:
        configured_provider = getattr(
            settings,
            "FAMILY_AGENT_HERMES_PROVIDER",
            "",
        ).strip()
        if configured_provider:
            return configured_provider.lower()

        normalized_model_name = self.model_name.strip().lower()
        if "/" in normalized_model_name:
            return normalized_model_name.split("/", 1)[0]
        if ":" in normalized_model_name:
            return normalized_model_name.split(":", 1)[0]
        if normalized_model_name.startswith("gemini"):
            return "gemini"
        if "claude" in normalized_model_name:
            return "anthropic"
        if normalized_model_name.startswith(("gpt-", "o1", "o3", "o4")):
            return "openai"
        return ""

    def _resolve_api_key(self) -> tuple[str, str]:
        explicit_api_key = getattr(settings, "FAMILY_AGENT_HERMES_API_KEY", "").strip()
        if explicit_api_key:
            return explicit_api_key, "FAMILY_AGENT_HERMES_API_KEY"

        if self._should_use_litellm_proxy():
            proxy_api_key = getattr(settings, "LITELLM_PROXY_API_KEY", "").strip()
            if proxy_api_key:
                return proxy_api_key, "LITELLM_PROXY_API_KEY"
            return "", "LITELLM_PROXY_API_KEY"

        provider_api_key_map = {
            "gemini": "GEMINI_API_KEY",
            "openai": "OPENAI_API_KEY",
            "anthropic": "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY",
            "openrouter": "OPENROUTER_API_KEY",
        }
        setting_name = provider_api_key_map.get(self.provider)
        if setting_name is None:
            return "", "FAMILY_AGENT_HERMES_API_KEY"
        return getattr(settings, setting_name, "").strip(), setting_name

    def _resolve_base_url(self) -> str:
        explicit_base_url = getattr(
            settings, "FAMILY_AGENT_HERMES_BASE_URL", ""
        ).strip()
        if explicit_base_url:
            return explicit_base_url

        # Route the built-in proxy alias through LiteLLM whenever the proxy URL
        # is configured, even if the alias was set explicitly in env. Other
        # explicit models still go to their provider endpoints unless the user
        # overrides FAMILY_AGENT_HERMES_BASE_URL directly.
        if self._should_use_litellm_proxy():
            proxy_base_url = getattr(settings, "LITELLM_PROXY_BASE_URL", "").strip()
            if proxy_base_url:
                return proxy_base_url

        provider_base_urls = {
            "gemini": "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai",
            "openai": "https://api.openai.com/v1",
            "anthropic": "https://api.anthropic.com",
            "openrouter": "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1",
        }
        return provider_base_urls.get(self.provider, "")

    def _normalize_model_name_for_provider(self) -> str:
        normalized_model_name = self.model_name.strip()
        if self._should_use_litellm_proxy():
            return normalized_model_name
        for separator in ("/", ":"):
            provider_prefix = f"{self.provider}{separator}"
            if normalized_model_name.lower().startswith(provider_prefix):
                return normalized_model_name[len(provider_prefix) :]
        return normalized_model_name

    def _resolve_hermes_provider(self) -> str:
        if self.provider == "openai" and self.base_url:
            # Hermes's auxiliary router does not register "openai" as a named
            # provider, but it can reuse the same endpoint cleanly through the
            # custom-provider path. Keeping planner runs on the main OpenAI
            # endpoint avoids misleading compression warnings for short-lived,
            # embedded sessions.
            return "custom"
        return self.provider

    def _build_agent(self) -> Any:
        from run_agent import AIAgent

        if not self.provider:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "Family planner could not determine an LLM provider from "
                f"FAMILY_AGENT_HERMES_MODEL={self.model_name!r}. "
                "Set FAMILY_AGENT_HERMES_PROVIDER explicitly."
            )
        if not self.api_key:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "Family planner is missing API credentials for "
                f"provider '{self.provider}'. Set {self.api_key_setting_name} "
                "in the backend environment."
            )

        return AIAgent(
            model=self.agent_model_name,
            provider=self.hermes_provider,
            api_key=self.api_key,
            base_url=self.base_url or None,
            quiet_mode=True,
            enabled_toolsets=["web", "browser"]
            if self.external_research_enabled
            else [],
            skip_memory=True,
            skip_context_files=True,
            max_iterations=self.max_iterations,
        )

    def _normalize_request_scope_text(self, value: Any) -> str:
        return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(value or "")).strip().lower()

    def _classify_request_scope(
        self,
        *,
        message_text: str,
        context: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> tuple[str, str]:
        normalized_message = self._normalize_request_scope_text(message_text)
        request_context = context.get("request_context")
        if not isinstance(request_context, dict):
            request_context = {}

        source_screen = self._normalize_request_scope_text(
            request_context.get("source_screen")
        )
        has_attachment_context = bool(
            context.get("current_message_attachments")
        ) or bool(
            self._normalize_request_scope_text(
                context.get("current_message_attachment_summary")
            )
        )
        has_focus_context = (
            any(
                str(request_context.get(key) or "").strip()
                for key in ("event_id", "trip_id", "group_id", "capture_id")
            )
            or bool(context.get("focused_event"))
            or bool(context.get("focused_capture"))
        )
        has_organize_context = source_screen in {
            "today",
            "desktop_home",
            "desktop_capture",
            "desktop_shopping",
        } and any(
            context.get(key)
            for key in ("task_snapshot", "list_snapshot", "chore_snapshot")
        )
        has_thread_context = bool(context.get("recent_messages"))
        has_planner_topic_term = any(
            term in normalized_message for term in _PLANNER_TOPIC_TERMS
        )
        has_calendar_link_signal = bool(
            re.search(
                r"\bwebcal://\S+|\bhttps?://\S+\.ics(?:[?#]\S*)?",
                normalized_message,
                flags=re.IGNORECASE,
            )
        )
        has_schedule_term = any(
            term in normalized_message for term in _PLANNER_SCHEDULE_TERMS
        ) or bool(
            re.search(
                r"\b\d{1,2}(?::\d{2})?\s?(?:a\.?m\.?|p\.?m\.?)\b",
                normalized_message,
                flags=re.IGNORECASE,
            )
        )
        has_planner_intent = any(
            re.search(pattern, normalized_message, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
            for pattern in _PLANNER_INTENT_PATTERNS
        )
        has_out_of_scope_intent = any(
            re.search(pattern, normalized_message, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
            for pattern in _OUT_OF_SCOPE_REQUEST_PATTERNS
        )

        if has_out_of_scope_intent:
            return _REQUEST_SCOPE_OUT_OF_SCOPE, "generic_request"
        if has_attachment_context:
            return _REQUEST_SCOPE_IN_SCOPE, "attachment_context"
        if has_focus_context:
            return _REQUEST_SCOPE_IN_SCOPE, "focused_context"
        if has_calendar_link_signal:
            return _REQUEST_SCOPE_IN_SCOPE, "calendar_link"
        if has_planner_topic_term:
            return _REQUEST_SCOPE_IN_SCOPE, "planner_keywords"
        if has_organize_context and (has_planner_intent or has_schedule_term):
            return _REQUEST_SCOPE_IN_SCOPE, "organize_context"
        if has_thread_context and (has_planner_intent or has_schedule_term):
            return _REQUEST_SCOPE_IN_SCOPE, "thread_follow_up"
        if source_screen in _PLANNER_CONTEXT_SCREENS and has_planner_intent:
            return _REQUEST_SCOPE_IN_SCOPE, "screen_context"
        if has_planner_intent:
            return _REQUEST_SCOPE_IN_SCOPE, "planner_intent"
        if has_schedule_term and source_screen in _PLANNER_CONTEXT_SCREENS:
            return _REQUEST_SCOPE_IN_SCOPE, "screen_schedule_reference"
        return _REQUEST_SCOPE_OUT_OF_SCOPE, "no_planner_signal"

    def build_context(
        self,
        *,
        user: User,
        family: FamilyGroup,
        message_text: str,
        context_payload: dict[str, Any],
        thread: Any = None,
        trigger_message: FamilyAgentMessage | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        context = self.tool_adapter.build_runtime_context(
            user=user,
            family=family,
            thread=thread,
            trigger_message=trigger_message,
            message_text=message_text,
            context_payload=context_payload,
        )
        normalized_context = dict(context)
        normalized_context.pop("events", None)
        normalized_context["planner_clock"] = self._build_planner_clock()
        normalized_context["availability_tools"] = (
            self._build_availability_tool_context()
        )
        normalized_context["tool_contracts"] = describe_tool_contracts()
        coerced: dict[str, Any] = coerce_for_json(normalized_context)
        return coerced

    def _build_availability_tool_context(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "tool_names": [
                "query_calendar_day",
                "query_calendar_blocks",
                "check_time_blocked",
                "get_event_details",
                "search_calendar_events",
                "get_user_location",
                "find_nearby_restaurants",
                "search_ucp_products",
            ],
            "scopes": {
                "immediate_family": {
                    "description": "Full planner visibility for the current immediate family.",
                    "member_filters_supported": True,
                },
                "network_public": {
                    "description": "Only PUBLIC events from connected families in the active META network.",
                    "member_filters_supported": False,
                    "requires_group_id": True,
                },
            },
            "member_filter_examples": ["user:123", "child:456"],

    def _planner_timezone(self) -> ZoneInfo:
        cached = getattr(self, "_planner_timezone_cache", None)
        if cached is None:
            cached = ZoneInfo(str(getattr(settings, "TIME_ZONE", "America/New_York")))
            self._planner_timezone_cache = cached
        return cached

    def _local_day_bounds(self, local_date: date) -> tuple[datetime, datetime]:
        local_start = datetime.combine(
            local_date,
            time.min,
            tzinfo=self._planner_timezone(),
        )
        return local_start, local_start + timedelta(days=1)

    def _build_planner_clock(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        tz = self._planner_timezone()
        local_now = timezone.localtime(timezone.now(), tz)
        today_start, today_end = self._local_day_bounds(local_now.date())
        return {
            "timezone": str(tz),
            "local_now": local_now.isoformat(),
            "local_date": local_now.date().isoformat(),
            "today_start_time": today_start.isoformat(),
            "today_end_time": today_end.isoformat(),
        }

    def _resolve_local_day_request(
        self,
        *,
        message_text: str,
        context_payload: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> date | None:
        selected_date = self.tool_adapter._parse_selected_date(
            context_payload.get("selected_date")
        )
        if selected_date is not None:
            return selected_date

        if re.search(r"\b(?:today(?:['’]s)?|tonight)\b", message_text.lower()):
            return timezone.localtime(timezone.now(), self._planner_timezone()).date()

        return None

    def _is_calendar_day_window(self, start_time: datetime, end_time: datetime) -> bool:
        duration = end_time - start_time
        if not timedelta(hours=23) <= duration <= timedelta(hours=25):
            return False
        return start_time.time() == time.min and end_time.time() == time.min

    def _normalize_local_day_tool_arguments(
        self,
        *,
        tool_name: str,
        arguments: dict[str, Any],
        message_text: str,
        context_payload: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if tool_name not in _LOCAL_DAY_CALENDAR_TOOLS:
            return arguments

        local_date = self._resolve_local_day_request(
            message_text=message_text,
            context_payload=context_payload,
        )
        if local_date is None:
            return arguments

        try:
            requested_start = self.tool_adapter._parse_event_datetime(
                arguments.get("start_time"),
                field_name="start_time",
            )
            requested_end = self.tool_adapter._parse_event_datetime(
                arguments.get("end_time"),
                field_name="end_time",
            )
        except ValueError:
            return arguments

        if not self._is_calendar_day_window(requested_start, requested_end):
            return arguments

        local_start, local_end = self._local_day_bounds(local_date)
        if requested_start == local_start and requested_end == local_end:
            return arguments

        normalized_arguments = dict(arguments)
        normalized_arguments["start_time"] = local_start.isoformat()
        normalized_arguments["end_time"] = local_end.isoformat()
        return normalized_arguments

            "active META network. "

    def _build_user_prompt(self, *, message_text: str, context: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
        return (
            "Plan around this user request and cite any web research you use.\n\n"
            f"User request:\n{message_text}\n\n"
            "Allowed ClanCal context:\n"
            f"{json.dumps(context, default=str)}\n\n"
            "Attachment grounding rules:\n"
            "- Treat current_message_attachments, current_message_attachment_summary, and recent_image_attachments as extracted evidence, not permission to guess.\n"
            "- Use attachment analysis fields like event_title_visible, event_title, visible_text, key_facts, and unknown_fields as the grounded image evidence.\n"
            "- If an attachment does not explicitly name the event, keep the event title unknown and do not use web research to guess it.\n\n"
            "If you need calendar availability, event detail, or deeper organize "
            "task/list/chore detail beyond the provided summaries, need to apply a "
            "requested Group Plan date response, or need to preview an external calendar "
            "subscription link before approval, need to resolve a Calendly scheduling link, "
            "list Calendly slots, or prepare a selected Calendly booking, return a tool_request for one backend "
            "tool call. Return only JSON."
        )

    def _build_tool_result_prompt(
        self,
        *,
        tool_name: str,
        tool_arguments: dict[str, Any],
        tool_result: Any,
    ) -> str:
        return (
            "ClanCal tool result:\n"
            f"{json.dumps({'tool_name': tool_name, 'tool_arguments': tool_arguments, 'tool_result': tool_result}, default=str)}\n\n"
            "Continue the same task. Request another backend tool only if needed. "
            "Return only JSON."

    def _execute_tool_request(
        self,
        *,
        user: User,
        family: FamilyGroup,
        context_payload: dict[str, Any],
        tool_request: Any,
        message_text: str = "",
    ) -> tuple[str, dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
        if not isinstance(tool_request, dict):
            raise ValueError("tool_request must be an object.")

        tool_name = str(tool_request.get("name") or "").strip()
        tool_arguments = tool_request.get("arguments") or {}
        if not isinstance(tool_arguments, dict):
            raise ValueError("tool_request.arguments must be an object.")

        entry = TOOL_REQUEST_REGISTRY.get(tool_name)
        if entry is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported tool_request name: {tool_name}")
        method_name, serializer_cls = entry

        serializer = serializer_cls(data=tool_arguments)
        if not serializer.is_valid():
            raise ValueError(
                f"Invalid arguments for tool_request[{tool_name}]: {serializer.errors}"
            )
        validated_arguments: dict[str, Any] = dict(serializer.validated_data)
        validated_arguments = self._normalize_local_day_tool_arguments(
            tool_name=tool_name,
            arguments=validated_arguments,
            message_text=message_text,
            context_payload=context_payload,
        )

        method = getattr(self.tool_adapter, method_name)
        signature = inspect.signature(method)
        accepts_var_kwargs = any(
            parameter.kind == inspect.Parameter.VAR_KEYWORD
            for parameter in signature.parameters.values()
        )
        call_kwargs: dict[str, Any] = dict(validated_arguments)
        for key, value in {
            "user": user,
            "family": family,
            "context_payload": context_payload,
        }.items():
            if accepts_var_kwargs or key in signature.parameters:
                call_kwargs[key] = value

        try:
            signature.bind(**call_kwargs)
        except TypeError as exc:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Argument binding failed for tool_request[{tool_name}]: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        try:
            result = method(**call_kwargs)
        except TypeError as exc:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Adapter call failed for tool_request[{tool_name}]: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        normalized_result = coerce_for_json(result)
        validate_json_payload(normalized_result, f"tool_request[{tool_name}]")
        return tool_name, validated_arguments, normalized_result

    def _extract_json(self, raw_text: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        try:
            parsed: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(raw_text)
            return parsed
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            match = re.search(r"\{.*\}", raw_text, re.DOTALL)
            if not match:
                return {
                    "assistant_text": raw_text.strip(),
                    "citations": [],
                    "proposals": [],
                    "memory_suggestions": [],
                    "action_suggestions": [],
                }
            from_match: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(match.group(0))
            return from_match

    def _normalize_proposal(
        self,
        proposal: Any,
        *,
        context_payload: dict[str, Any],
        family: FamilyGroup,
    ) -> dict[str, Any] | Any:
        if not isinstance(proposal, dict):
            return proposal

        normalized_proposal = dict(proposal)
        is_family_network_context = str(
            context_payload.get("source_screen") or ""
        ).strip() == "family_network" and bool(
            str(context_payload.get("group_id") or "").strip()
        )
        if not is_family_network_context:
            return normalized_proposal

        return self.tool_adapter.normalize_family_network_group_plan_proposal(
            normalized_proposal,
            context_group_id=str(context_payload.get("group_id") or "").strip() or None,
            family=family,
        )

    def _normalize_proposals(
        self,
        proposals: list[Any],
        *,
        context_payload: dict[str, Any],
        family: FamilyGroup,
    ) -> list[Any]:
        return [
            self._normalize_proposal(
                proposal,
                context_payload=context_payload,
                family=family,
            )
            for proposal in proposals
        ]

class FamilyAgentRuntimeUsageError(RuntimeError):
    def __init__(self, message: str, *, usage_json: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        super().__init__(message)
        self.usage_json = usage_json


def _message_byte_size(message: Any) -> int:
    if isinstance(message, dict):
        try:
            return len(json.dumps(message, default=str))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return len(str(message))
    return len(str(message))


def _compact_history(history: Any, *, max_chars: int) -> Any:
    """Stub older tool messages once cumulative size exceeds `max_chars`.

    Keeps system messages, the latest user prompt, and the latest assistant turn
    intact. Older tool / assistant turns get replaced with a small placeholder so
    the model still sees the call shape without paying their byte cost.
    """
    if not isinstance(history, list) or not history:
        return history
    sizes = [_message_byte_size(m) for m in history]
    total = sum(sizes)
    if total <= max_chars:
        return history

    keep_indexes: set[int] = set()
    for idx, msg in enumerate(history):
        if isinstance(msg, dict) and str(msg.get("role", "")).lower() == "system":
            keep_indexes.add(idx)
    if history:
        keep_indexes.add(len(history) - 1)
    if len(history) >= 2:
        keep_indexes.add(len(history) - 2)

    compacted: list[Any] = []
    for idx, msg in enumerate(history):
        if idx in keep_indexes:
            compacted.append(msg)
            continue
        if not isinstance(msg, dict):
            compacted.append(msg)
            continue
        role = str(msg.get("role", "")).lower()
        if role in {"tool", "function", "assistant", "user"}:
            tool_name = msg.get("name") or msg.get("tool_call_id") or "prior"
            compacted.append(
                {
                    "role": role,
                    "content": f"[omitted prior {role} content: {tool_name}, "
                    f"{sizes[idx]}B]",
                }
            )
        else:
            compacted.append(msg)
    return compacted

class HermesFamilyPlannerRuntime:
    runtime_name = "hermes"
    availability_tool_iteration_limit = 6

    def __init__(
        self,
        tool_adapter: FamilyPlannerToolAdapter | None = None,
        *,
        external_research_enabled: bool = True,
        budget_service: FamilyAgentBudgetService | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.tool_adapter = tool_adapter or FamilyPlannerToolAdapter()
        self.external_research_enabled = external_research_enabled
        self.budget_service = budget_service or FamilyAgentBudgetService()
        explicit_model = getattr(settings, "FAMILY_AGENT_HERMES_MODEL", "").strip()
        proxy_base_url = getattr(settings, "LITELLM_PROXY_BASE_URL", "").strip()
        # Only route to the LiteLLM proxy when we are using the default proxy
        # alias (no explicit model) AND the proxy URL is configured. An
        # explicit model must never use the proxy branch, otherwise the
        # provider's API key would be sent to the internal proxy URL.
        self._using_proxy_default = bool(proxy_base_url) and not explicit_model
        self.model_name = self._resolve_model_name()
        self.provider = self._resolve_provider()
        self.agent_model_name = self._normalize_model_name_for_provider()
        self.base_url = self._resolve_base_url()
        self.hermes_provider = self._resolve_hermes_provider()
        self.api_key, self.api_key_setting_name = self._resolve_api_key()
        self.max_iterations = int(
            getattr(settings, "FAMILY_AGENT_HERMES_MAX_ITERATIONS", 10)
        )

    def _resolve_model_name(self) -> str:
        configured_model = getattr(settings, "FAMILY_AGENT_HERMES_MODEL", "").strip()
        if configured_model:
            return configured_model
        if self._using_proxy_default:
            return _DEFAULT_PLANNER_PROXY_MODEL
        configured_provider = getattr(
            settings, "FAMILY_AGENT_HERMES_PROVIDER", ""
        ).strip()
        if configured_provider:
            normalized_provider = configured_provider.lower()
            if normalized_provider == "gemini":
                return _DEFAULT_PLANNER_DIRECT_MODEL
            if normalized_provider == "openai":
                return "openai/gpt-5.4-mini"
            if normalized_provider == "anthropic":
                return "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4"
        return _DEFAULT_PLANNER_DIRECT_MODEL

    def _should_use_litellm_proxy(self) -> bool:
        proxy_base_url = getattr(settings, "LITELLM_PROXY_BASE_URL", "").strip()
        explicit_base_url = getattr(
            settings, "FAMILY_AGENT_HERMES_BASE_URL", ""
        ).strip()
        if not proxy_base_url or explicit_base_url:
            return False
        return self._using_proxy_default or (
            self.model_name.strip().lower() == _DEFAULT_PLANNER_PROXY_MODEL.lower()
        )

    def _resolve_provider(self) -> str:
        configured_provider = getattr(
            settings,
            "FAMILY_AGENT_HERMES_PROVIDER",
            "",
        ).strip()
        if configured_provider:
            return configured_provider.lower()

        normalized_model_name = self.model_name.strip().lower()
        if "/" in normalized_model_name:
            return normalized_model_name.split("/", 1)[0]
        if ":" in normalized_model_name:
            return normalized_model_name.split(":", 1)[0]
        if normalized_model_name.startswith("gemini"):
            return "gemini"
        if "claude" in normalized_model_name:
            return "anthropic"
        if normalized_model_name.startswith(("gpt-", "o1", "o3", "o4")):
            return "openai"
        return ""

    def _resolve_api_key(self) -> tuple[str, str]:
        explicit_api_key = getattr(settings, "FAMILY_AGENT_HERMES_API_KEY", "").strip()
        if explicit_api_key:
            return explicit_api_key, "FAMILY_AGENT_HERMES_API_KEY"

        if self._should_use_litellm_proxy():
            proxy_api_key = getattr(settings, "LITELLM_PROXY_API_KEY", "").strip()
            if proxy_api_key:
                return proxy_api_key, "LITELLM_PROXY_API_KEY"
            return "", "LITELLM_PROXY_API_KEY"

        provider_api_key_map = {
            "gemini": "GEMINI_API_KEY",
            "openai": "OPENAI_API_KEY",
            "anthropic": "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY",
            "openrouter": "OPENROUTER_API_KEY",
        }
        setting_name = provider_api_key_map.get(self.provider)
        if setting_name is None:
            return "", "FAMILY_AGENT_HERMES_API_KEY"
        return getattr(settings, setting_name, "").strip(), setting_name

    def _resolve_base_url(self) -> str:
        explicit_base_url = getattr(
            settings, "FAMILY_AGENT_HERMES_BASE_URL", ""
        ).strip()
        if explicit_base_url:
            return explicit_base_url

        # Route the built-in proxy alias through LiteLLM whenever the proxy URL
        # is configured, even if the alias was set explicitly in env. Other
        # explicit models still go to their provider endpoints unless the user
        # overrides FAMILY_AGENT_HERMES_BASE_URL directly.
        if self._should_use_litellm_proxy():
            proxy_base_url = getattr(settings, "LITELLM_PROXY_BASE_URL", "").strip()
            if proxy_base_url:
                return proxy_base_url

        provider_base_urls = {
            "gemini": "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai",
            "openai": "https://api.openai.com/v1",
            "anthropic": "https://api.anthropic.com",
            "openrouter": "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1",
        }
        return provider_base_urls.get(self.provider, "")

    def _normalize_model_name_for_provider(self) -> str:
        normalized_model_name = self.model_name.strip()
        if self._should_use_litellm_proxy():
            return normalized_model_name
        for separator in ("/", ":"):
            provider_prefix = f"{self.provider}{separator}"
            if normalized_model_name.lower().startswith(provider_prefix):
                return normalized_model_name[len(provider_prefix) :]
        return normalized_model_name

    def _resolve_hermes_provider(self) -> str:
        if self.provider == "openai" and self.base_url:
            # Hermes's auxiliary router does not register "openai" as a named
            # provider, but it can reuse the same endpoint cleanly through the
            # custom-provider path. Keeping planner runs on the main OpenAI
            # endpoint avoids misleading compression warnings for short-lived,
            # embedded sessions.
            return "custom"
        return self.provider

    def _build_agent(self) -> Any:
        from run_agent import AIAgent

        if not self.provider:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "Family planner could not determine an LLM provider from "
                f"FAMILY_AGENT_HERMES_MODEL={self.model_name!r}. "
                "Set FAMILY_AGENT_HERMES_PROVIDER explicitly."
            )
        if not self.api_key:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "Family planner is missing API credentials for "
                f"provider '{self.provider}'. Set {self.api_key_setting_name} "
                "in the backend environment."
            )

        return AIAgent(
            model=self.agent_model_name,
            provider=self.hermes_provider,
            api_key=self.api_key,
            base_url=self.base_url or None,
            quiet_mode=True,
            enabled_toolsets=["web", "browser"]
            if self.external_research_enabled
            else [],
            skip_memory=True,
            skip_context_files=True,
            max_iterations=self.max_iterations,
        )

    def _normalize_request_scope_text(self, value: Any) -> str:
        return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(value or "")).strip().lower()

    def _classify_request_scope(
        self,
        *,
        message_text: str,
        context: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> tuple[str, str]:
        normalized_message = self._normalize_request_scope_text(message_text)
        request_context = context.get("request_context")
        if not isinstance(request_context, dict):
            request_context = {}

        source_screen = self._normalize_request_scope_text(
            request_context.get("source_screen")
        )
        has_attachment_context = bool(
            context.get("current_message_attachments")
        ) or bool(
            self._normalize_request_scope_text(
                context.get("current_message_attachment_summary")
            )
        )
        has_focus_context = (
            any(
                str(request_context.get(key) or "").strip()
                for key in ("event_id", "trip_id", "group_id", "capture_id")
            )
            or bool(context.get("focused_event"))
            or bool(context.get("focused_capture"))
        )
        has_organize_context = source_screen in {
            "today",
            "desktop_home",
            "desktop_capture",
            "desktop_shopping",
        } and any(
            context.get(key)
            for key in ("task_snapshot", "list_snapshot", "chore_snapshot")
        )
        has_thread_context = bool(context.get("recent_messages"))
        has_planner_topic_term = any(
            term in normalized_message for term in _PLANNER_TOPIC_TERMS
        )
        has_calendar_link_signal = bool(
            re.search(
                r"\bwebcal://\S+|\bhttps?://\S+\.ics(?:[?#]\S*)?",
                normalized_message,
                flags=re.IGNORECASE,
            )
        )
        has_schedule_term = any(
            term in normalized_message for term in _PLANNER_SCHEDULE_TERMS
        ) or bool(
            re.search(
                r"\b\d{1,2}(?::\d{2})?\s?(?:a\.?m\.?|p\.?m\.?)\b",
                normalized_message,
                flags=re.IGNORECASE,
            )
        )
        has_planner_intent = any(
            re.search(pattern, normalized_message, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
            for pattern in _PLANNER_INTENT_PATTERNS
        )
        has_out_of_scope_intent = any(
            re.search(pattern, normalized_message, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
            for pattern in _OUT_OF_SCOPE_REQUEST_PATTERNS
        )

        if has_out_of_scope_intent:
            return _REQUEST_SCOPE_OUT_OF_SCOPE, "generic_request"
        if has_attachment_context:
            return _REQUEST_SCOPE_IN_SCOPE, "attachment_context"
        if has_focus_context:
            return _REQUEST_SCOPE_IN_SCOPE, "focused_context"
        if has_calendar_link_signal:
            return _REQUEST_SCOPE_IN_SCOPE, "calendar_link"
        if has_planner_topic_term:
            return _REQUEST_SCOPE_IN_SCOPE, "planner_keywords"
        if has_organize_context and (has_planner_intent or has_schedule_term):
            return _REQUEST_SCOPE_IN_SCOPE, "organize_context"
        if has_thread_context and (has_planner_intent or has_schedule_term):
            return _REQUEST_SCOPE_IN_SCOPE, "thread_follow_up"
        if source_screen in _PLANNER_CONTEXT_SCREENS and has_planner_intent:
            return _REQUEST_SCOPE_IN_SCOPE, "screen_context"
        if has_planner_intent:
            return _REQUEST_SCOPE_IN_SCOPE, "planner_intent"
        if has_schedule_term and source_screen in _PLANNER_CONTEXT_SCREENS:
            return _REQUEST_SCOPE_IN_SCOPE, "screen_schedule_reference"
        return _REQUEST_SCOPE_OUT_OF_SCOPE, "no_planner_signal"

    def build_context(
        self,
        *,
        user: User,
        family: FamilyGroup,
        message_text: str,
        context_payload: dict[str, Any],
        thread: Any = None,
        trigger_message: FamilyAgentMessage | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        context = self.tool_adapter.build_runtime_context(
            user=user,
            family=family,
            thread=thread,
            trigger_message=trigger_message,
            message_text=message_text,
            context_payload=context_payload,
        )
        normalized_context = dict(context)
        normalized_context.pop("events", None)
        normalized_context["planner_clock"] = self._build_planner_clock()
        normalized_context["availability_tools"] = (
            self._build_availability_tool_context()
        )
        normalized_context["tool_contracts"] = describe_tool_contracts()
        coerced: dict[str, Any] = coerce_for_json(normalized_context)
        return coerced

    def _planner_timezone(self) -> ZoneInfo:
        cached = getattr(self, "_planner_timezone_cache", None)
        if cached is None:
            cached = ZoneInfo(str(getattr(settings, "TIME_ZONE", "America/New_York")))
            self._planner_timezone_cache = cached
        return cached

    def _local_day_bounds(self, local_date: date) -> tuple[datetime, datetime]:
        local_start = datetime.combine(
            local_date,
            time.min,
            tzinfo=self._planner_timezone(),
        )
        return local_start, local_start + timedelta(days=1)

    def _build_planner_clock(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        tz = self._planner_timezone()
        local_now = timezone.localtime(timezone.now(), tz)
        today_start, today_end = self._local_day_bounds(local_now.date())
        return {
            "timezone": str(tz),
            "local_now": local_now.isoformat(),
            "local_date": local_now.date().isoformat(),
            "today_start_time": today_start.isoformat(),
            "today_end_time": today_end.isoformat(),
        }

    def _resolve_local_day_request(
        self,
        *,
        message_text: str,
        context_payload: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> date | None:
        selected_date = self.tool_adapter._parse_selected_date(
            context_payload.get("selected_date")
        )
        if selected_date is not None:
            return selected_date

        if re.search(r"\b(?:today(?:['’]s)?|tonight)\b", message_text.lower()):
            return timezone.localtime(timezone.now(), self._planner_timezone()).date()

        return None

    def _is_calendar_day_window(self, start_time: datetime, end_time: datetime) -> bool:
        duration = end_time - start_time
        if not timedelta(hours=23) <= duration <= timedelta(hours=25):
            return False
        return start_time.time() == time.min and end_time.time() == time.min

    def _normalize_local_day_tool_arguments(
        self,
        *,
        tool_name: str,
        arguments: dict[str, Any],
        message_text: str,
        context_payload: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if tool_name not in _LOCAL_DAY_CALENDAR_TOOLS:
            return arguments

        local_date = self._resolve_local_day_request(
            message_text=message_text,
            context_payload=context_payload,
        )
        if local_date is None:
            return arguments

        try:
            requested_start = self.tool_adapter._parse_event_datetime(
                arguments.get("start_time"),
                field_name="start_time",
            )
            requested_end = self.tool_adapter._parse_event_datetime(
                arguments.get("end_time"),
                field_name="end_time",
            )
        except ValueError:
            return arguments

        if not self._is_calendar_day_window(requested_start, requested_end):
            return arguments

        local_start, local_end = self._local_day_bounds(local_date)
        if requested_start == local_start and requested_end == local_end:
            return arguments

        normalized_arguments = dict(arguments)
        normalized_arguments["start_time"] = local_start.isoformat()
        normalized_arguments["end_time"] = local_end.isoformat()
        return normalized_arguments

            "returns proposal_ready=true. If scheduling tools return requires_handoff=true, "

            "using the provided handoff_url so the user can finish in Calendly. "

    def _build_user_prompt(self, *, message_text: str, context: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
        return (
            "Plan around this user request and cite any web research you use.\n\n"
            f"User request:\n{message_text}\n\n"
            "Allowed ClanCal context:\n"
            f"{json.dumps(context, default=str)}\n\n"
            "Attachment grounding rules:\n"
            "- Treat current_message_attachments, current_message_attachment_summary, and recent_image_attachments as extracted evidence, not permission to guess.\n"
            "- Use attachment analysis fields like event_title_visible, event_title, visible_text, key_facts, and unknown_fields as the grounded image evidence.\n"
            "- If an attachment does not explicitly name the event, keep the event title unknown and do not use web research to guess it.\n\n"
            "If you need calendar availability, event detail, or deeper organize "
            "task/list/chore detail beyond the provided summaries, need to apply a "
            "requested Group Plan date response, or need to preview an external calendar "
            "subscription link before approval, need to resolve a Calendly scheduling link, "
            "list Calendly slots, or prepare a selected Calendly booking, return a tool_request for one backend "
            "tool call. Return only JSON."
        )

    def _build_tool_result_prompt(
        self,
        *,
        tool_name: str,
        tool_arguments: dict[str, Any],
        tool_result: Any,
    ) -> str:
        return (
            "ClanCal tool result:\n"
            f"{json.dumps({'tool_name': tool_name, 'tool_arguments': tool_arguments, 'tool_result': tool_result}, default=str)}\n\n"
            "Continue the same task. Request another backend tool only if needed. "
            "Return only JSON."
        )

    def _execute_tool_request(
        self,
        *,
        user: User,
        family: FamilyGroup,
        context_payload: dict[str, Any],
        tool_request: Any,
        message_text: str = "",
    ) -> tuple[str, dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
        if not isinstance(tool_request, dict):
            raise ValueError("tool_request must be an object.")

        tool_name = str(tool_request.get("name") or "").strip()
        tool_arguments = tool_request.get("arguments") or {}
        if not isinstance(tool_arguments, dict):
            raise ValueError("tool_request.arguments must be an object.")

        entry = TOOL_REQUEST_REGISTRY.get(tool_name)
        if entry is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported tool_request name: {tool_name}")
        method_name, serializer_cls = entry

        serializer = serializer_cls(data=tool_arguments)
        if not serializer.is_valid():
            raise ValueError(
                f"Invalid arguments for tool_request[{tool_name}]: {serializer.errors}"
            )
        validated_arguments: dict[str, Any] = dict(serializer.validated_data)
        validated_arguments = self._normalize_local_day_tool_arguments(
            tool_name=tool_name,
            arguments=validated_arguments,
            message_text=message_text,
            context_payload=context_payload,
        )

        method = getattr(self.tool_adapter, method_name)
        signature = inspect.signature(method)
        accepts_var_kwargs = any(
            parameter.kind == inspect.Parameter.VAR_KEYWORD
            for parameter in signature.parameters.values()
        )
        call_kwargs: dict[str, Any] = dict(validated_arguments)
        for key, value in {
            "user": user,
            "family": family,
            "context_payload": context_payload,
        }.items():
            if accepts_var_kwargs or key in signature.parameters:
                call_kwargs[key] = value

        try:
            signature.bind(**call_kwargs)
        except TypeError as exc:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Argument binding failed for tool_request[{tool_name}]: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        try:
            result = method(**call_kwargs)
        except TypeError as exc:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Adapter call failed for tool_request[{tool_name}]: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        normalized_result = coerce_for_json(result)
        validate_json_payload(normalized_result, f"tool_request[{tool_name}]")
        return tool_name, validated_arguments, normalized_result

    def _extract_json(self, raw_text: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        try:
            parsed: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(raw_text)
            return parsed
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            match = re.search(r"\{.*\}", raw_text, re.DOTALL)
            if not match:
                return {
                    "assistant_text": raw_text.strip(),
                    "citations": [],
                    "proposals": [],
                    "memory_suggestions": [],
                    "action_suggestions": [],
                }
            from_match: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(match.group(0))
            return from_match

    def _normalize_proposal(
        self,
        proposal: Any,
        *,
        context_payload: dict[str, Any],
        family: FamilyGroup,
    ) -> dict[str, Any] | Any:
        if not isinstance(proposal, dict):
            return proposal

        normalized_proposal = dict(proposal)
        is_family_network_context = str(
            context_payload.get("source_screen") or ""
        ).strip() == "family_network" and bool(
            str(context_payload.get("group_id") or "").strip()
        )
        if not is_family_network_context:
            return normalized_proposal

        return self.tool_adapter.normalize_family_network_group_plan_proposal(
            normalized_proposal,
            context_group_id=str(context_payload.get("group_id") or "").strip() or None,
            family=family,
        )

    def _normalize_proposals(
        self,
        proposals: list[Any],
        *,
        context_payload: dict[str, Any],
        family: FamilyGroup,
    ) -> list[Any]:
        return [
            self._normalize_proposal(
                proposal,
                context_payload=context_payload,
                family=family,
            )
            for proposal in proposals
        ]

    def execute(
        self,
        *,
        user: User,
        family: FamilyGroup,
        message_text: str,
        context_payload: dict[str, Any],
        thread: Any = None,
        trigger_message: FamilyAgentMessage | None = None,
        run_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        availability_tool_calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        estimated_input_tokens = 0
        estimated_output_tokens = 0
        estimated_total_cost_micros = 0
        model_call_count = 0
        request_scope = "unknown"
        scope_reason = "not_classified"
        last_message_count = 0
        last_task_id = None
        entity_links: list[dict[str, str]] = []

        def build_usage_json() -> dict[str, Any]:
            usage_json = coerce_for_json(
                {
                    "message_count": last_message_count,
                    "task_id": last_task_id,
                    "availability_tool_calls": availability_tool_calls,
                    "request_scope": request_scope,
                    "scope_reason": scope_reason,
                    "estimated_input_tokens": estimated_input_tokens,
                    "estimated_output_tokens": estimated_output_tokens,
                    "estimated_total_cost_micros": estimated_total_cost_micros,
                    "model_call_count": model_call_count,
                }
            )
            return usage_json if isinstance(usage_json, dict) else {}

        logger.info(
            "Family planner runtime starting run_id=%s thread_id=%s family_id=%s "
            "user_id=%s model_name=%s provider=%s hermes_provider=%s "
            "has_base_url=%s has_api_key=%s "
            "max_iterations=%s text_length=%s context_keys=%s",
            run_id or "unknown",
            getattr(thread, "id", None),
            family.id,
            user.id,
            self.model_name,
            self.provider,
            self.hermes_provider,
            bool(self.base_url),
            bool(self.api_key),
            self.max_iterations,
            len(message_text),
            sorted(context_payload.keys()),
        )
        context = self.build_context(
            user=user,
            family=family,
            message_text=message_text,
            context_payload=context_payload,
            thread=thread,
            trigger_message=trigger_message,
        )
        try:
            request_scope, scope_reason = self._classify_request_scope(
                message_text=message_text,
                context=context,
            )
            if request_scope == _REQUEST_SCOPE_OUT_OF_SCOPE:
                usage_json = coerce_for_json(
                    {
                        "message_count": 0,
                        "task_id": None,
                        "availability_tool_calls": [],
                        "request_scope": request_scope,
                        "scope_reason": scope_reason,
                    }
                )
                validate_json_payload(context, "result['context']")
                validate_json_payload(usage_json, "result['usage_json']")
                logger.info(
                    "Family planner runtime rejected out-of-scope request run_id=%s thread_id=%s family_id=%s reason=%s",
                    run_id or "unknown",
                    getattr(thread, "id", None),
                    family.id,
                    scope_reason,
                )
                return {
                    "assistant_text": _OUT_OF_SCOPE_ASSISTANT_TEXT,
                    "citations": [],
                    "action_suggestions": [],
                    "proposals": [],
                    "memory_suggestions": [],
                    "entity_links": [],
                    "usage_json": usage_json,
                    "context": context,
                }

            agent = self._build_agent()
            system_message = self._build_system_message()
            user_prompt = self._build_user_prompt(
                message_text=message_text,
                context=context,
            )
            entity_link_seen: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
            merge_unique(
                entity_links,
                entity_link_seen,
                extract_entity_links_from_context(context),
            )
            conversation_history = None
            result = None

            for _ in range(self.availability_tool_iteration_limit):
                (
                    prompt_input_tokens,
                    prompt_output_tokens,
                    prompt_cost_micros,
                ) = self.budget_service.estimate_prompt_cost_micros(
                    system_message=system_message,
                    user_prompt=user_prompt,
                )
                self.budget_service.enforce_budget(
                    family=family,
                    user=user,
                    estimated_increment_micros=(
                        estimated_total_cost_micros + prompt_cost_micros
                    ),
                )
                estimated_input_tokens += prompt_input_tokens
                estimated_output_tokens += prompt_output_tokens
                estimated_total_cost_micros += prompt_cost_micros
                model_call_count += 1
                run_kwargs = {
                    "user_message": user_prompt,
                    "system_message": system_message,
                }
                if conversation_history is not None:
                    run_kwargs["conversation_history"] = conversation_history
                result = agent.run_conversation(**run_kwargs)
                last_message_count = len(result.get("messages", []))
                last_task_id = result.get("task_id")
                if result.get("failed"):
                    raise RuntimeError(
                        result.get("error")
                        or "Family planner agent failed without a response."
                    )

                parsed = self._extract_json(result["final_response"])
                tool_request = parsed.get("tool_request")
                if not tool_request:
                    break

                try:
                    tool_name, tool_arguments, tool_result = self._execute_tool_request(
                        user=user,
                        family=family,
                        context_payload=context_payload,
                        tool_request=tool_request,
                        message_text=message_text,
                    )
                except (
                    ValueError,
                    TypeError,
                    drf_serializers.ValidationError,
                ) as exc:
                    tool_name = (
                        str(tool_request.get("name") or "").strip()
                        if isinstance(tool_request, dict)
                        else ""
                    )
                    raw_arguments = (
                        tool_request.get("arguments")
                        if isinstance(tool_request, dict)
                        and isinstance(tool_request.get("arguments"), dict)
                        else {}
                    )
                    tool_arguments = (
                        dict(raw_arguments) if isinstance(raw_arguments, dict) else {}
                    )
                    tool_result = {"ok": False, "error": str(exc)}

                availability_tool_calls.append(
                    {
                        "name": tool_name,
                        "arguments": tool_arguments,
                    }
                )
                merge_unique(
                    entity_links,
                    entity_link_seen,
                    extract_entity_links_from_tool_result(
                        tool_name=tool_name,
                        tool_result=tool_result,
                    ),
                )
                conversation_history = result.get("messages")
                last_message_count = len(conversation_history or [])
                last_task_id = result.get("task_id")
                user_prompt = self._build_tool_result_prompt(
                    tool_name=tool_name,
                    tool_arguments=tool_arguments,
                    tool_result=tool_result,
                )
            else:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "Family planner exceeded the availability tool iteration limit."
                )

            if result is None:
                raise RuntimeError("Family planner agent did not produce a response.")

            parsed = self._extract_json(result["final_response"])
            assistant_text = str(
                parsed.get("assistant_text") or result["final_response"] or ""
            )
            citations = coerce_for_json(parsed.get("citations") or [])
            action_suggestions = coerce_for_json(parsed.get("action_suggestions") or [])
            proposals = self._normalize_proposals(
                parsed.get("proposals") or [],
                context_payload=context_payload,
                family=family,
            )
            proposals = coerce_for_json(proposals)
            assistant_text = self.tool_adapter.sanitize_family_network_assistant_text(
                assistant_text,
                proposals=proposals,
                context_payload=context_payload,
            )
            memory_suggestions = coerce_for_json(parsed.get("memory_suggestions") or [])
            usage_json = build_usage_json()
            validate_json_payload(citations, "result['citations']")
            validate_json_payload(action_suggestions, "result['action_suggestions']")
            validate_json_payload(proposals, "result['proposals']")
            validate_json_payload(memory_suggestions, "result['memory_suggestions']")
            validate_json_payload(entity_links, "result['entity_links']")
            validate_json_payload(context, "result['context']")
            validate_json_payload(usage_json, "result['usage_json']")
            logger.info(
                "Family planner runtime completed run_id=%s thread_id=%s family_id=%s citations=%s action_suggestions=%s proposals=%s memory_suggestions=%s message_count=%s hermes_task_id=%s",
                run_id or "unknown",
                getattr(thread, "id", None),
                family.id,
                len(citations),
                len(action_suggestions),
                len(proposals),
                len(memory_suggestions),
                usage_json["message_count"],
                usage_json["task_id"],
            )
            return {
                "assistant_text": assistant_text,
                "citations": citations,
                "action_suggestions": action_suggestions,
                "proposals": proposals,
                "memory_suggestions": memory_suggestions,
                "entity_links": entity_links,
                "usage_json": usage_json,
                "context": context,
            }
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.exception(
                "Family planner runtime failed run_id=%s thread_id=%s family_id=%s user_id=%s",
                run_id or "unknown",
                getattr(thread, "id", None),
                family.id,
                user.id,
            )
            usage_json = build_usage_json()
            if usage_json.get("estimated_total_cost_micros") or usage_json.get(
                "model_call_count"
            ):
                raise FamilyAgentRuntimeUsageError(
                    str(exc),
                    usage_json=usage_json,
                ) from exc
            raise

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import timedelta

import pytest
from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.utils import timezone

from family_agent.models import FamilyAgentThread
from family_agent.thread_router import (
    normalize_page_scope,
    resolve_effective_thread,
    token_pressure,
)
from users.models import FamilyGroup, FamilyMembership, UserProfile


def _create_user(*, username: str, family: FamilyGroup) -> User:
    user = User.objects.create_user(
        username=username,
        email=f"{username}@example.com",
        password="pass",  # pragma: allowlist secret
    )
    FamilyMembership.objects.create(
        user=user,
        family=family,
        role="PARENT",
        is_admin=True,
    )
    profile = UserProfile.objects.get(user=user)
    profile.primary_family = family
    profile.save(update_fields=["primary_family"])
    return user


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "source_screen,expected",
    [
        ("today", "today"),
        ("today_dashboard", "today"),
        ("today-overview", "today"),
        ("event_detail", "event"),
        ("event", "event"),
        ("trip_planning", "trip"),
        ("vacation_detail", "trip"),
        ("household_dashboard", "household"),
        (None, ""),
        ("", ""),
        ("calendar", ""),
        ("desktop_capture", ""),
    ],
)
def test_normalize_page_scope(source_screen, expected) -> None:
    assert normalize_page_scope(source_screen) == expected


def test_token_pressure_thresholds(settings) -> None:
    settings.FAMILY_AGENT_SOFT_WARN_TOKENS = 150_000
    settings.FAMILY_AGENT_HARD_SPLIT_TOKENS = 200_000
    assert token_pressure(0) == "ok"
    assert token_pressure(149_999) == "ok"
    assert token_pressure(150_000) == "warning"
    assert token_pressure(199_999) == "warning"
    assert token_pressure(200_000) == "critical"
    assert token_pressure(500_000) == "critical"


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_resolve_creates_new_thread_when_none_exist() -> None:
    family = FamilyGroup.objects.create(name="Router Family")
    user = _create_user(username="router_a", family=family)

    resolution = resolve_effective_thread(
        family=family,
        user=user,
        source_screen="today_dashboard",
    )

    assert not resolution.split_occurred
    assert resolution.closed_thread_id is None
    assert resolution.thread.page_scope == FamilyAgentThread.PageScope.TODAY


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_resolve_reuses_active_scoped_thread() -> None:
    family = FamilyGroup.objects.create(name="Router Family")
    user = _create_user(username="router_b", family=family)
    existing = FamilyAgentThread.objects.create(
        family=family,
        created_by=user,
        page_scope=FamilyAgentThread.PageScope.TODAY,
    )

    resolution = resolve_effective_thread(
        family=family,
        user=user,
        source_screen="today",
    )

    assert resolution.thread.pk == existing.pk
    assert not resolution.split_occurred


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_resolve_splits_on_idle_timeout(settings) -> None:
    settings.FAMILY_AGENT_IDLE_THREAD_HOURS = 1
    family = FamilyGroup.objects.create(name="Router Family")
    user = _create_user(username="router_c", family=family)
    stale = FamilyAgentThread.objects.create(
        family=family,
        created_by=user,
        page_scope=FamilyAgentThread.PageScope.TODAY,
    )
    FamilyAgentThread.objects.filter(pk=stale.pk).update(
        updated_at=timezone.now() - timedelta(hours=3)
    )
    stale.refresh_from_db()

    resolution = resolve_effective_thread(
        family=family,
        user=user,
        source_screen="today",
    )

    assert resolution.split_occurred
    assert resolution.closed_reason == FamilyAgentThread.ClosedReason.IDLE_TIMEOUT
    assert resolution.closed_thread_id == str(stale.pk)
    assert resolution.thread.pk != stale.pk
    stale.refresh_from_db()
    assert stale.is_archived is True


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_resolve_splits_on_token_threshold(settings) -> None:
    settings.FAMILY_AGENT_HARD_SPLIT_TOKENS = 200_000
    family = FamilyGroup.objects.create(name="Router Family")
    user = _create_user(username="router_d", family=family)
    busy = FamilyAgentThread.objects.create(
        family=family,
        created_by=user,
        page_scope=FamilyAgentThread.PageScope.TODAY,
        prompt_tokens_estimate=210_000,
    )

    resolution = resolve_effective_thread(
        family=family,
        user=user,
        source_screen="today",
    )

    assert resolution.split_occurred
    assert resolution.closed_reason == FamilyAgentThread.ClosedReason.TOKEN_THRESHOLD
    assert resolution.thread.pk != busy.pk
    assert resolution.thread.parent_thread_id == busy.pk


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_resolve_creates_scoped_thread_when_page_changes() -> None:
    family = FamilyGroup.objects.create(name="Router Family")
    user = _create_user(username="router_e", family=family)
    today_thread = FamilyAgentThread.objects.create(
        family=family,
        created_by=user,
        page_scope=FamilyAgentThread.PageScope.TODAY,
    )

    resolution = resolve_effective_thread(
        family=family,
        user=user,
        source_screen="event_detail",
        requested_thread_id=str(today_thread.pk),
    )

    # Should NOT close today_thread; should create or reuse an event-scoped one.
    assert resolution.thread.page_scope == FamilyAgentThread.PageScope.EVENT
    today_thread.refresh_from_db()
    assert today_thread.is_archived is False

from __future__ import annotations

import json

from family_agent.runtime import _compact_history
from family_agent.tool_adapter import _apply_context_size_budget


def test_compact_history_keeps_system_user_and_last_assistant() -> None:
    history = [
        {"role": "system", "content": "Important system rules"},
        {"role": "user", "content": "A" * 1000},
        {"role": "tool", "name": "load_events", "content": "B" * 50_000},
        {"role": "tool", "name": "load_events", "content": "C" * 50_000},
        {"role": "assistant", "content": "Final answer in progress"},
    ]
    compacted = _compact_history(history, max_chars=2000)
    assert isinstance(compacted, list)
    assert compacted[0]["role"] == "system"
    # Last two must be preserved verbatim (latest user prompt + assistant).
    assert compacted[-1] == history[-1]
    assert compacted[-2] == history[-2]
    # Middle tool messages must be stubbed (much smaller).
    for msg in compacted[1:-2]:
        if isinstance(msg, dict) and msg["role"] == "tool":
            assert "[omitted prior" in msg["content"]


def test_compact_history_returns_unchanged_when_under_budget() -> None:
    history = [
        {"role": "system", "content": "x"},
        {"role": "user", "content": "hi"},
        {"role": "assistant", "content": "hello"},
    ]
    assert _compact_history(history, max_chars=1_000) == history


def test_compact_history_handles_non_dict_entries() -> None:
    history = ["raw-1", "raw-2"]
    # Should not crash even with non-dict entries.
    assert _compact_history(history, max_chars=2) == history


def test_apply_context_size_budget_trims_large_lists() -> None:
    big_event = {"title": "x" * 1000}
    context = {
        "events": [dict(big_event) for _ in range(200)],
        "tentative_shares": [dict(big_event) for _ in range(50)],
        "task_snapshot": {
            "tasks": [dict(big_event) for _ in range(100)],
        },
        "request_context": {"source_screen": "today"},
        "latest_user_message": "hi",
    }
    trimmed = _apply_context_size_budget(context, max_chars=20_000)
    final_size = len(json.dumps(trimmed, default=str))
    assert final_size <= 60_000  # gave room for marker overhead
    assert isinstance(trimmed["events"], list)
    # Marker must be present somewhere when trimming kicked in.
    assert any(
        isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("truncated")
        for item in trimmed["events"]
    )


def test_apply_context_size_budget_noop_when_small() -> None:
    context = {"events": [{"x": 1}, {"x": 2}]}
    assert _apply_context_size_budget(context, max_chars=100_000) == context

from __future__ import annotations

from unittest.mock import patch

import pytest
from django.contrib.auth.models import User

from family_agent.models import FamilyAgentMessage, FamilyAgentThread
from family_agent.tasks import (
    _accumulate_thread_token_estimate,
    summarize_thread_for_handoff,
)
from users.models import FamilyGroup, FamilyMembership, UserProfile


def _user(username: str, family: FamilyGroup) -> User:
    user = User.objects.create_user(
        username=username,
        email=f"{username}@example.com",
        password="pass",  # pragma: allowlist secret
    )
    FamilyMembership.objects.create(
        user=user, family=family, role="PARENT", is_admin=True
    )
    profile = UserProfile.objects.get(user=user)
    profile.primary_family = family
    profile.save(update_fields=["primary_family"])
    return user


class _FakeChoice:
    def __init__(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.message = type("M", (), {"content": text})()


class _FakeResponse:
    def __init__(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.choices = [_FakeChoice(text)]


class _FakeClient:
    def __init__(self, text: str = "Family is finalizing Saturday hike plan.") -> None:
        self._text = text

        class _Completions:
            outer = self

            def create(self_inner, **kwargs):  # noqa: N805
                return _FakeResponse(self_inner.outer._text)

        class _Chat:
            outer = self

            def __init__(self_inner) -> None:
                self_inner.completions = _Completions()

        self.chat = _Chat()


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_summarize_thread_for_handoff_writes_summary_and_carryover() -> None:
    family = FamilyGroup.objects.create(name="Handoff Family")
    user = _user("handoff_a", family)
    closed = FamilyAgentThread.objects.create(family=family, created_by=user)
    new_thread = FamilyAgentThread.objects.create(
        family=family, created_by=user, parent_thread=closed
    )
    FamilyAgentMessage.objects.create(
        thread=closed, author_user=user, role="user", text="Plan Saturday hike."
    )
    FamilyAgentMessage.objects.create(
        thread=closed,
        author_user=None,
        role="assistant",
        text="Sure, looking at trails.",
    )

    with (
        patch("family_agent.tasks.AIClient", create=True, return_value=_FakeClient()),
        patch(
            "family_agent.tasks.get_workload_model",
            create=True,
            return_value="openai/gpt-4o-mini",
        ),
    ):
        result = summarize_thread_for_handoff(str(closed.pk), str(new_thread.pk))

    assert result["status"] == "ok"
    closed.refresh_from_db()
    assert "Saturday" in closed.summary_text
    carryover = FamilyAgentMessage.objects.filter(
        thread=new_thread, role=FamilyAgentMessage.Role.SYSTEM
    ).first()
    assert carryover is not None
    assert carryover.text.startswith("[Continued from prior thread]")


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_summarize_thread_skips_when_missing_thread() -> None:
    fake_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
    result = summarize_thread_for_handoff(fake_id, fake_id)
    assert result["status"] == "skipped"


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_accumulate_thread_token_estimate_increments() -> None:
    family = FamilyGroup.objects.create(name="Token Family")
    user = _user("tok_a", family)
    thread = FamilyAgentThread.objects.create(family=family, created_by=user)
    from family_agent.models import FamilyAgentRun

    run = FamilyAgentRun.objects.create(thread=thread, status="COMPLETED")
    _accumulate_thread_token_estimate(run, 5_000)
    _accumulate_thread_token_estimate(run, 3_000)
    thread.refresh_from_db()
    assert thread.prompt_tokens_estimate == 8_000

        r"\bready\s+(?:for|to)\s+approval\b",
        r"\bonce you approve this\b",
